IAiEcommerceSellerBusinessProfiles.IRequ.description:
AI E-Commerce Seller Business Profile request filter for paginated, filterable search/list operations. Used as the request body for PATCH endpoints when admin or compliance users want to list, filter, or search seller business profile entities for onboarding, regulatory reporting, or audit dashboards.

This schema covers search terms such as business name, business registration number, status, country, and time window for profile creation, as well as advanced filters for compliance reporting and KKYC requirements. All parameters are atomic, and the object is designed to be extended for future filtering capabilities, following 3NF principles (no joined aggregate keys). Fields here should be fully documented, highly descriptive, and reference business context for explainability.

Mapped to ai_ecommerce_seller_business_profiles in the data model. See also: IPageIAiEcommerceSellerBusinessProfiles for result container.

page.description: Results page number, starting from 1. Used for paginated API listings.

limit.description: Number of records per page, used for paging efficiency and client-side navigation.

search.description: Fuzzy or partial match search term for business name, tax ID, or registration number. Used for flexible matching in UI search filters.

country.description: Country or region filter. For use in compliance/region-specific searches. Typically ISO country code.

status.description: Business profile status filter. May include values like 'active', 'deleted', 'pending_approval', etc. Enum/allowed values enforced in API implementation.

created_from.description: Filter for business profiles created after this timestamp. Useful for time window/reporting queries.

created_to.description: Filter for business profiles created before this timestamp.

IPageIAiEcommerceSellerBusinessProfiles.description:
Paginated result container for seller business profile list API responses. Used to deliver IPage semantics (records + pagination meta) for ai_ecommerce_seller_business_profiles query endpoints.

Always conforms to the IPage<T> OpenAPI paging pattern. Each result page contains: (1) pagination metadata, (2) business profile data array. Top-level context for list and dashboard APIs.

pagination.description: Pagination information for current query.

data.description: Array of seller business profile response objects for this page.

ISellerBusinessProfile.description:
Detailed business profile information for one seller, covering all fields required by onboarding, compliance, and legal documentation. This schema fully captures all normalization/atomicity per ai_ecommerce_seller_business_profiles table. It is designed for detail views and reporting, including context for regulatory review and auditability.

References: Seller entity, business information required for verification, legal documents, and system onboarding logs. This model MUST be used wherever a seller's legal business registration data is needed by external or platform admins. Contains only atomic/compliance-relevant fields; no aggregates or UI-only artifacts.

Mapped to ai_ecommerce_seller_business_profiles in the data model and ERD.

id.description: Primary key. Globally unique identifier for the seller business profile record. Used as the main entity reference for lookups, audits, and updates.

seller_id.description: Foreign key to the seller (business account) owning this business profile. Used for 1:1 mapping from seller account to legal business registration.

business_name.description: Registered name of the seller's business. This field is required for all business verification, contract, and regulatory workflows. Not user-editable after approval.

business_registration_number.description: Unique government-issued business registration or license number. Used for official verification, tax compliance, and cross-border validation.

tax_id.description: Registered business tax identifier. Nullable for jurisdictions that do not issue tax IDs. Used in all financial reporting and compliance reviews.

contact_name.description: Official point-of-contact name for the business entity. Legal or regulatory correspondence is addressed to this contact.

contact_phone.description: Primary business contact phone. Should be globally valid and accessible for verification and support.

contact_email.description: Business communication email address (not a personal email). Required for legal correspondence and onboarding notifications.

address_line1.description: First line of the business address (street/road/building, etc).

address_line2.description: Optional second line of address for units, floors, or complex addresses.

city.description: Business city. Used in location, compliance, tax, and jurisdictional analytics.

state.description: Business state/province (ISO or regional format as appropriate).

postal_code.description: Postal or ZIP code for the business location.

country.description: Country for official business registration. Typically ISO country code.

created_at.description: Timestamp of profile record creation. Used for audit/traceability.

updated_at.description: Last modification timestamp for business profile atomics.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp field when profile was soft-deleted/deactivated, or null if active.

ISellerBusinessProfile.ICreate.description:
Request schema for creating a new seller business profile record during onboarding/compliance/regulatory flow. All atomic fields that must be provided by the user (seller/admin) for business registration are included. This variant should match the logical business registration workflow (required fields for the jurisdiction).

Maps to ai_ecommerce_seller_business_profiles. See also: ISellerBusinessProfile for output objects.

seller_id.description: FK to the business seller to whom this business profile will be appended. Seller account must already exist.

business_registration_number.description: Official business registration/license number issued by government authority.

tax_id.description: Official business tax identifier, if available for the jurisdiction. May be nullable on creation.

contact_name.description: Point-of-contact for business verification or audit calls.

contact_phone.description: Phone number for POC. Should be globally reachable; validated by normalization rules.

contact_email.description: Email for business communication and official onboarding notifications.

address_line1.description: First address line (for delivery, audit, or registration formalities).

address_line2.description: Optional field for secondary address line, e.g., suite, unit, floor.

postal_code.description: Postal or ZIP code for address.

country.description: Country code or name. Typically ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format.

ISellerBusinessProfile.IUpdate.description:
Request schema for updating a seller business profile record by PK (id). Used for audit/compliance corrections, address change, or legal updates. Only allowed by admin or owner for mutable fields. Follows strict 3NF: only atomic/legal-allowed field updates; no aggregates or state calculation here.

Maps to ai_ecommerce_seller_business_profiles.

business_name.description: (Optional) New/updated legal business name if changed. Not usually editable after approval but included for legal amendments.

business_registration_number.description: (Optional) New/updated business registration number after government update. Rarely changes.

tax_id.description: (Optional) Updated tax identification number for business or country move.

contact_name.description: (Optional) New/updated business contact name in case of change.

contact_phone.description: (Optional) New/updated phone number for business contact.

city.description: (Optional) Updated or corrected city for address.

state.description: (Optional) Updated or corrected state/province for address.

country.description: (Optional) Updated or corrected country for business.

ISellerOnboardingLogs.IRequest.description:
Request schema for filtering/searching onboarding logs for a seller's onboarding process. Supports PATCH/search for onboarding logs, used by admin/compliance teams for workflow review and forensic audit.

Based on ai_ecommerce_seller_onboarding_logs table. Allows filtering by seller id, business profile id, administrator (actor), step, decision state, and date range.

All filters are atomic and reference only IDs/fields that directly exist in the log or its FK refs.

limit.description: Result count per page

seller_id.description: Specific seller (business account) ID to search logs for

business_profile_id.description: FK for business profile, supports audit trail narrowing

administrator_id.description: FK for admin who acted/created the onboarding log

action.description: Nature of onboarding action (accept, reject, flag, etc)

decision_state.description: Decision state after onboarding action (pending, approved, rejected, escalated, etc)

created_from.description: Filter onboarding logs after this time

created_to.description: Filter onboarding logs before this time

IPageISellerOnboardingLog.description: Paginated result container for seller onboarding log API responses. Always follows the IPage<T> pattern, including a 'pagination' object and an array of ISellerOnboardingLog.

pagination.description: Pagination meta for onboarding logs

data.description: Array of onboarding log event detail objects.

ISellerOnboardingLog.description:
Full detail record for a seller onboarding log event. Mirrors the ai_ecommerce_seller_onboarding_logs model for enum/log display and compliance. Contains all key FKs to seller/business profile, actor, and workflow state, rationale, and action meta.

Each entry is atomic and audit-grade for regulatory and operational review.

id.description: Primary/PK for this onboarding log entry

seller_id.description: FK of the owner seller

administrator_id.description: FK of admin actor, if manually performed

step.description: Code or label for the onboarding workflow step

action.description: Onboarding action (e.g., accept, reject, escalate, etc)

decision_state.description: State after action (pending, approved, rejected, etc)

reason_detail.description: Rationale or freeform context note/reason for action

created_at.description: Event timestamp

ISellerOnboardingLog.ICreate.description: Request schema to create a seller onboarding log record. Used for importing audit or compliance documentation, workflow events, or automated onboarding traces. Requires all FKs and context details for a full atomic audit row. Maps to ai_ecommerce_seller_onboarding_logs PK set.

seller_id.description: FK to the owning seller

business_profile_id.description: FK to the business profile being onboarded

administrator_id.description: FK to the admin actor (optional, if system performed)

actor_type.description: Role of the actor performing onboarding event ('system', 'admin', etc)

ISellerOnboardingLog.IUpdate.description: Request schema to update an existing seller onboarding log record, used for rare compliance/audit corrections. Matches atomic model, all fields fully described.

ISellerVerificationDocuments.IRequest.description:
Request schema to filter/search seller verification documents by document type, status, issue/expiry, seller/profile FK. Used for PATCH list/search endpoints that support onboarding/doc compliance and regulatory workflow management. Each field is atomic, with full legal tracing.

Mapped to ai_ecommerce_seller_verification_documents.

limit.description: Docs per page

seller_id.description: FK of seller to search for

document_type.description: Filter for document type, e.g., 'business_registration', 'tax_certificate', etc.

IPageISellerVerificationDocument.description: Paginated result page for seller verification document list/search. Each page holds a pagination meta and array of doc result objects (one per document/event).

pagination.description: Standard pagination info

data.description: Array of seller verification document result records

id.description: The unique identifier for the seller verification document. This property uniquely distinguishes each submitted document. Reference: ai_ecommerce_seller_verification_documents.id column.

seller_id.description: Foreign key to the seller who submitted the document. Links the verification document to a specific seller entity for onboarding and compliance workflows. Reference: ai_ecommerce_seller_verification_documents.seller_id column.

business_profile_id.description: Foreign key to the business profile associated with this verification document. Ensures correct association of documents for onboarding and audit purposes. Reference: ai_ecommerce_seller_verification_documents.business_profile_id column.

document_type.description: The type/category of the submitted verification document (e.g., 'business_registration', 'tax_certificate'). This helps the compliance and onboarding process categorize and validate required paperwork. Reference: ai_ecommerce_seller_verification_documents.document_type column.

document_file_url.description: The URL pointing to the uploaded document (e.g., on S3 or other storage). Required for subsequent retrieval or audit. Reference: ai_ecommerce_seller_verification_documents.document_file_url column.

issue_date.description: Date/time when the document was issued by the authority. Used for validity/expiry verification. Reference: ai_ecommerce_seller_verification_documents.issue_date column.

oneOf.description: If applicable, the date/time when the document expires. Null if the document is evergreen or has no expiry. Reference: ai_ecommerce_seller_verification_documents.expiry_date column.

expiry_date.description: If applicable, the date/time when the document expires. Null if the document is evergreen or has no expiry. Reference: ai_ecommerce_seller_verification_documents.expiry_date column.

oneOf.description: Timestamp when this document was verified by platform admin or compliance staff. Null if not yet verified. Used for audit and compliance tracking. Reference: ai_ecommerce_seller_verification_documents.verified_at column.

verified_at.description: Timestamp when this document was verified by platform admin or compliance staff. Null if not yet verified. Used for audit and compliance tracking. Reference: ai_ecommerce_seller_verification_documents.verified_at column.

oneOf.description: Soft deletion timestamp for compliance/audit practices. Null if document is active. Reference: ai_ecommerce_seller_verification_documents.deleted_at column.

deleted_at.description: Soft deletion timestamp for compliance/audit practices. Null if document is active. Reference: ai_ecommerce_seller_verification_documents.deleted_at column.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the verification document entity was created. Used for full audit trail support. Reference: ai_ecommerce_seller_verification_documents.created_at column.

ISellerVerificationDocument.description:
Represents an official verification, business registration, or compliance document submitted by a seller during or after onboarding. Documents include business licenses, tax certificates, and other legal paperwork subject to audit. Tracks document lifecycle, verification, and expiry for regulatory and onboarding workflows. Reference: ai_ecommerce_seller_verification_documents table, Seller/Admin Management requirements.

Properties mirror the columns of the ai_ecommerce_seller_verification_documents schema, and each field is critical for audit, regulatory, and business onboarding processes.

seller_id.description: Foreign key to the seller submitting the document. Links submission to a unique business account. Reference: ai_ecommerce_seller_verification_documents.seller_id column.

business_profile_id.description: Business profile id associated with the submitted document. Provides association with the relevant business registration profile. Reference: ai_ecommerce_seller_verification_documents.business_profile_id column.

document_type.description: Category/type of the verification document required in onboarding processes (e.g., 'business_registration'). Reference: ai_ecommerce_seller_verification_documents.document_type column.

document_file_url.description: The URI/link to the uploaded document file in cloud storage—used to fetch for compliance review and onboarding audit. Reference: ai_ecommerce_seller_verification_documents.document_file_url column.

issue_date.description: The date the document was issued, used by compliance for validation and checking expiry.

oneOf.description: The expiry date (if known/applicable). Null for evergreen documents or those without specified expiration.

expiry_date.description: The expiry date (if known/applicable). Null for evergreen documents or those without specified expiration.

ISellerVerificationDocument.ICreate.description:
Request structure for creating a new verification document submission by a seller. Used in onboarding or compliance flows. Implements all required business/compliance metadata and file URI registration. Reference: ai_ecommerce_seller_verification_documents table, Seller/Admin Management documentation.

Includes only the fields necessary for registration/submission—system-assigned fields (id, timestamps, etc.) are excluded.

document_type.description: Updated or corrected document type (e.g. 'business_registration', 'tax_certificate'). Mutability subject to compliance rules.

document_file_url.description: Changed file URL if document is re-uploaded or replaced. Must reflect new/updated location if present.

issue_date.description: Updates/corrects the document's issue date for compliance. Used for correcting data-entry or upload errors.

oneOf.description: Replacement or addition of document expiry. Set to new date or null if expiring/evergreen.

expiry_date.description: Replacement or addition of document expiry. Set to new date or null if expiring/evergreen.

oneOf.description: When a document is newly or re-verified by platform administrator or compliance staff. Used for approval logging and workflow escalation.

verified_at.description: When a document is newly or re-verified by platform administrator or compliance staff. Used for approval logging and workflow escalation.

oneOf.description: Marks the document as deleted (soft-delete, null if making active again). This must only be changed by compliance/admin.

deleted_at.description: Marks the document as deleted (soft-delete, null if making active again). This must only be changed by compliance/admin.

IAiEcommerceSellerVerificationDocument.I.description: Update structure for editing a seller's verification document submission for the onboarding/compliance process. Includes all fields that can be modified after original submission, according to business and regulatory constraints. Some values may be mutable only by platform admins or under audit staff direction. Reference: ai_ecommerce_seller_verification_documents table, Seller/Admin Management documentation.

id.description: UUID primary key uniquely identifying each verification document submission for a seller, as registered in ai_ecommerce_seller_verification_documents.id.

seller_id.description: Foreign key to the seller submitting the document (business account linking).

business_profile_id.description: Business profile associated with this verification document.

document_type.description: Type/category of the submitted document, such as 'business_registration', 'tax_certificate', or other regulatory paperwork.

document_file_url.description: URL/path to uploaded document file in persistent storage.

issue_date.description: Authority issued date for the document (regulatory/compliance).

oneOf.description: Document expiration if applicable (can be null for perpetual documents).

expiry_date.description: Document expiration if applicable (can be null for perpetual documents).

oneOf.description: The date/time the document was verified (null if unverified or pending).

verified_at.description: The date/time the document was verified (null if unverified or pending).

created_at.description: System-created timestamp for audit and regulatory tracking.

updated_at.description: When the document record (metadata only) was last changed (does not imply resubmission). For legacy audit and change tracking.

oneOf.description: Indicates a soft-deleted document; null if still active/visible.

deleted_at.description: Indicates a soft-deleted document; null if still active/visible.

IAiEcommerceSellerVerificationDocument.description: Implements the full normalized structure for a seller onboarding/compliance verification document attachment. Includes metadata for all document types, lifecycle states, audit, and reference links. Reference: ai_ecommerce_seller_verification_documents, Platform compliance requirements.

id.description: UUID of the deleted verification document.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when the document was logically removed from active onboarding and compliance review (soft-delete for audit).

IAiEcommerceSellerVerificationDocument.I.description: Deletion response/result object for a seller's verification document in the onboarding/compliance system. Captures deletion audit state for traceability and compliance requirements. Reference: ai_ecommerce_seller_verification_documents.

oneOf.description: Filter by administrator (actor) id performing the action, if present. Used for audit log queries, admin compliance reviews.

administrator_id.description: Filter by administrator (actor) id performing the action, if present. Used for audit log queries, admin compliance reviews.

role_id.description: Filter logs by specific role id involved in the action, e.g., for privilege escalation detection or onboarding logs.

target_type.description: Restrict logs to a specific resource type (e.g., user, seller, system_policy). Used for focused search and filter in compliance queries.

action_type.description: Restricts logs to specific action types (e.g. 'onboarding_approve', 'role_grant'). For operational/audit reporting.

Sort direction for the paging results: 'asc' or 'desc'.

IAiEcommerceAdminActionLog.IRequest.description: Search/filter request model for paginated retrieval of administrator action log records. Supports audit, compliance, dashboard, and analytics workflows for privileged actions in Seller/Admin Management.

data.description: Array of admin action log entries for the result page.

IPageIAiEcommerceAdminActionLog.description: Container for paginated results of administrator action log search/queries. Provides page metadata and data arrays for UI, audit, and compliance review. Reference: Standard IPage container.

administrator_id.description: Foreign key to administrator who performed the action.

action_detail.description: Correction or update to the rationale or detail for the event.

IAiEcommerceAdminActionLog.IUpdate.description: Modification model for admin action log events. Used for corrections/amendments to previously recorded actions in support of compliance rules. Reference: ai_ecommerce_admin_action_logs schema.

id.description: Action log id for compliance record/statistics.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp this log was marked as deleted.

IAiEcommerceAdminActionLog.IDelete.description: Represents the outcome or confirmation of a delete operation for an administrator action log event. Used for audit reporting, dashboard state update, and compliance recordkeeping.

IAiEcommerceRole.IRequest.description: Search/query model for paginated platform RBAC roles lists, allowing precise filter, search, and UI update behaviors. Used in administration tools for AI-powered e-commerce platform. Reference: ai_ecommerce_roles table, Seller/Admin Management.

pagination.description:
페이지네이션 정보입니다.

현재 페이지, 페이지당 항목 수, 전체 레코드 수, 전체 페이지 수 등의 정보가 포함됩니다. 이는 각 리스트 API에서 결과 집합의 탐색과 관리에 사용됩니다.

data.description:
이 페이지에 포함된 ai_ecommerce_role 엔티티 객체들의 배열입니다.

각 객체는 RBAC(역할 기반 접근 제어) 역할 정의를 나타내며, 상세 설명은 IAiEcommerceRole 스키마를 참고하세요.

IPageIAiEcommerceRole.description:
플랫폼 RBAC(역할 기반 접근 제어) 역할 정의의 페이지네이션된 결과 컨테이너입니다.

이 타입은 ai_ecommerce_roles 목록 API의 표준 반환값으로, 페이지 정보와 역할 객체 배열을 포함합니다. 이를 통해 대규모 역할 데이터셋의 효율적 탐색과 관리가 가능합니다.

id.description:
플랫폼 롤의 고유 식별자(UUID).

Prisma ai_ecommerce_roles 테이블의 id 필드에 해당하며, 각 RBAC 역할 엔터티를 시스템 내에서 식별하는 데 사용됩니다.

name.description:
RBAC 역할명.

Prisma ai_ecommerce_roles.name 컬럼에 해당하는 고유한 역할 이름입니다(예: 'administrator', 'seller', 'product_manager')

oneOf.description:
역할의 설명(선택).

Prisma ai_ecommerce_roles.description 컬럼과 일치합니다. 역할의 비즈니스 목적/권한 범위/유의사항을 서술하며, UI/도움말 등에 활용됩니다.

description.description:
역할의 설명(선택).

Prisma ai_ecommerce_roles.description 컬럼과 일치합니다. 역할의 비즈니스 목적/권한 범위/유의사항을 서술하며, UI/도움말 등에 활용됩니다.

created_at.description:
생성 일시(ISO 8601 형식).

Prisma ai_ecommerce_roles.created_at. 이 역할이 처음 시스템에 등록된 시각을 의미합니다.

updated_at.description:
최근 수정 일시(ISO 8601 형식).

Prisma ai_ecommerce_roles.updated_at. 역할 정보가 마지막으로 수정된 시각입니다.

IAiEcommerceRole.description:
플랫폼 RBAC(역할 기반 접근 제어)용 단일 역할(RBAC Role) 엔티티 객체입니다.

이 타입은 ai_ecommerce_roles 테이블의 한 행을 전체적으로 표현하며, 역할명, 설명, 생성/수정일 등의 속성 정보를 포함합니다. 역할 기반 권한 관리를 위한 마스터 레코드로 활용됩니다.

name.description:
생성할 RBAC 역할의 이름입니다. (예: 'administrator', 'seller', 'manager' 등)

Prisma ai_ecommerce_roles.name 과 동일하며, 반드시 고유(unique)값이어야 하며 이미 사용 중인 역할 이름은 불가합니다.

oneOf.description:
새 역할에 대한 설명(선택).

Prisma ai_ecommerce_roles.description 컬럼과 일치하며, 역할이 어떤 목적으로 쓰이는지 추가 설명을 위해 입력합니다.

description.description:
새 역할에 대한 설명(선택).

Prisma ai_ecommerce_roles.description 컬럼과 일치하며, 역할이 어떤 목적으로 쓰이는지 추가 설명을 위해 입력합니다.

IAiEcommerceRole.ICreate.description:
RBAC 역할(RBAC Role) 신규 생성 요청 객체.

플랫폼 운영자가 새로운 권한 역할을 만들 때 사용하는 데이터 포맷을 정의합니다. 이름 필드는 필수, 설명은 선택입니다.

name.description:
수정할 RBAC 역할의 새 이름입니다.

Prisma ai_ecommerce_roles.name 과 일치하며, 고유값(unique)이어야 합니다. 이름 변경 시 기존 역할과 중복되지 않도록 주의가 필요합니다.

oneOf.description:
수정할 역할 설명(선택).

이 역할이 무엇을 의미하는지, 어떤 권한/범위를 갖는지 추가 서술할 때 입력합니다. Prisma ai_ecommerce_roles.description 컬럼과 연동됩니다.

description.description:
수정할 역할 설명(선택).

이 역할이 무엇을 의미하는지, 어떤 권한/범위를 갖는지 추가 서술할 때 입력합니다. Prisma ai_ecommerce_roles.description 컬럼과 연동됩니다.

IAiEcommerceRole.IUpdate.description:
RBAC 역할(RBAC Role) 수정 시 사용되는 요청 객체 타입입니다.

수정 가능한 필드는 역할명(name) 및 설명(description) 입니다. ID 등 기본키는 변경할 수 없으며, 고유성(unique) 정책을 준수해야 합니다.

id.description:
삭제된 RBAC 역할의 고유 식별자(UUID)입니다.

해당 역할이 물리적으로 삭제되거나 논리적으로 삭제(soft) 처리된 후 결과로 반환됩니다.

deleted_at.description:
삭제 일시(ISO 8601).

역할이 삭제(또는 soft-delete) 처리된 시점을 나타냅니다.

IAiEcommerceRole.IDelete.description:
RBAC 역할 엔티티 삭제(soft/hard) 후 반환되는 표준 응답 객체입니다.

실제 롤 삭제와 동시에 삭제 ID/일시를 포함하여 클라이언트에 반환합니다. 감사, 컴플라이언스 기록에 활용됩니다.

oneOf.description:
권한 이름, 설명 등의 전체 또는 부분 문자열 검색어(선택).

목록 필터링, 빠른 찾기, UI 설계 등에서 사용됩니다.

search.description:
권한 이름, 설명 등의 전체 또는 부분 문자열 검색어(선택).

목록 필터링, 빠른 찾기, UI 설계 등에서 사용됩니다.

page.description:
페이지 번호(1-base 인덱스).

목록 또는 대규모 권한 데이터셋의 탐색에 필요합니다.

oneOf.description:
페이지당 결과 수(설정 가능, 기본값은 시스템 정의).

대량 데이터셋에서 UI 또는 API 호출 효율성을 위해 페이징 처리에 활용합니다.

limit.description:
페이지당 결과 수(설정 가능, 기본값은 시스템 정의).

대량 데이터셋에서 UI 또는 API 호출 효율성을 위해 페이징 처리에 활용합니다.

oneOf.description:
정렬 필드/방향 지정(예: "created_at_desc", "name_asc" 등).

UI 테이블/관리도구 상의 정렬 제어에 쓰입니다.

sort.description:
정렬 필드/방향 지정(예: "created_at_desc", "name_asc" 등).

UI 테이블/관리도구 상의 정렬 제어에 쓰입니다.

IAiEcommercePermission.IRequest.description:
권한(Permission) 목록의 서버 사이드 페이징/검색/정렬 요청 객체입니다.

ai_ecommerce_permissions의 권한 리스트를 효율적으로 탐색/검색할 수 있도록 구성되어 있습니다.

pagination.description:
페이지네이션 정보입니다.

현재 페이지 인덱스, 한 페이지 당 항목 수, 전체 개수, 전체 페이지 수 등의 정보로 구성됩니다.

data.description:
이 페이지 결과에 포함된 ai_ecommerce_permissions 엔티티 객체 배열입니다.

각 객체는 플랫폼 권한 엔티티(atomic permission)를 의미하며, 상세 항목/권한 설명은 IAiEcommercePermission 스키마 참고하세요.

IPageIAiEcommercePermission.description:
권한(Permission) 엔티티의 페이징 결과 데이터 타입.

ai_ecommerce_permissions 테이블의 목록(페이지) 데이터를 서버-클라이언트 간 직접 API 교환시 사용합니다.

id.description:
권한 식별자(UUID).

Prisma ai_ecommerce_permissions 테이블의 PK(id)입니다. 각 permission을 고유하게 식별하는 데 사용됩니다.

name.description:
권한명(고유).

예시: 'manage_orders', 'approve_seller', 등. ai_ecommerce_permissions.name 컬럼에 해당합니다.

oneOf.description:
권한 설명(선택).

Prisma ai_ecommerce_permissions.description에 대응하며 권한이 시스템 내에서 어떤 의미를 갖는지 UI, 도움말 등에서 표현합니다.

description.description:
권한 설명(선택).

Prisma ai_ecommerce_permissions.description에 대응하며 권한이 시스템 내에서 어떤 의미를 갖는지 UI, 도움말 등에서 표현합니다.

created_at.description:
권한 행이 생성된 일시(ISO 문자열).

Prisma ai_ecommerce_permissions.created_at에 저장된 값과 동일합니다.

IAiEcommercePermission.description:
단일 플랫폼 권한(Permission) 엔티티 전체 정보입니다.

각 permission은 RBAC 시스템 내 원자적 권한 단위로, 주로 roles와 매핑하여 요청자/액터의 허용된 동작을 세분화합니다.

name.description:
신규 권한(atomic permission)의 고유 이름.

예시: 'manage_orders', 'approve_seller'. DB 고유(unique) 인덱스 컬럼입니다.

oneOf.description:
신규 권한에 대한 추가 설명.

이 권한이 시스템적으로 어떠한 자원 또는 액션을 의미하는지 상세 설명을 위해 사용합니다.

description.description:
신규 권한에 대한 추가 설명.

이 권한이 시스템적으로 어떠한 자원 또는 액션을 의미하는지 상세 설명을 위해 사용합니다.

IAiEcommercePermission.ICreate.description:
플랫폼 atomic permission 신규 생성에 사용되는 데이터 타입입니다.

RBAC/권한관리 시스템에서 새로운 권한 단위를 추가할 때 요청 페이로드로 사용됩니다.

name.description:
수정할 권한의 새 이름(고유).

ai_ecommerce_permissions.name 컬럼으로, 권한명 변경 시 중복이 없어야 합니다.

oneOf.description:
수정 권한 설명.

description 필드는 권한의 역할, 특징, 실제 허용 동작 등을 서술합니다.

description.description:
수정 권한 설명.

description 필드는 권한의 역할, 특징, 실제 허용 동작 등을 서술합니다.

IAiEcommercePermission.IUpdate.description:
권한(Permission) 엔티티 수정에 쓰이는 객체입니다.

변경 가능한 필드는 name과 description 입니다. PK 등은 수정 불가하고, schema·비즈니스 규칙상 고유값 제한에 유의해야 합니다.

id.description:
삭제된 권한 엔터티의 고유 식별자.

실제 삭제(soft/hard) 후 클라이언트에 반환되는 id입니다.

deleted_at.description: 삭제(또는 논리적 삭제) 처리된 시각.

IAiEcommercePermission.IDeleteResponse.description:
권한(Permission) 엔티티 삭제처리(soft/hard) 후 리턴되는 표준 응답 객체입니다.

작업 성공 시 삭제된 PK와 timestamp가 포함되어 반환됩니다. 컴플라이언스 추적/로그에 활용 가능합니다.

oneOf.description:
제품명, 설명, 또는 기타 텍스트 기반 필드에 대한 전체문자열·부분문자열 검색조건.

카탈로그 검색 UI/서치 API에서 keyword 필터링에 활용합니다.

search.description:
제품명, 설명, 또는 기타 텍스트 기반 필드에 대한 전체문자열·부분문자열 검색조건.

카탈로그 검색 UI/서치 API에서 keyword 필터링에 활용합니다.

oneOf.description:
판매자 계정(회사 ap_ecommerce_sellers)의 고유 식별자(UUID)로 필터링.

특정 셀러의 상품만 조회할 때 사용합니다.

seller_id.description:
판매자 계정(회사 ap_ecommerce_sellers)의 고유 식별자(UUID)로 필터링.

특정 셀러의 상품만 조회할 때 사용합니다.

oneOf.description:
특정 상태(예: 'published', 'draft', 'pending', 'archived') 값으로 제품을 필터링.

Prisma ai_ecommerce_products.status 컬럼 기반, 관리자/셀러/구매자별로 다르게 활용할 수 있습니다.

status.description:
특정 상태(예: 'published', 'draft', 'pending', 'archived') 값으로 제품을 필터링.

Prisma ai_ecommerce_products.status 컬럼 기반, 관리자/셀러/구매자별로 다르게 활용할 수 있습니다.

oneOf.description:
승인/비승인/검토중 등 상품 승인 상태에 따른 필터.

ai_ecommerce_products.approval_state 값과 일치해야 하며, compliance/workflow에 따라 가공됩니다.

approval_state.description:
승인/비승인/검토중 등 상품 승인 상태에 따른 필터.

ai_ecommerce_products.approval_state 값과 일치해야 하며, compliance/workflow에 따라 가공됩니다.

oneOf.description:
상품 생성일 범위 시작(검색조건; ISO8601 형식 날짜).

특정 기간 내 등록 상품만 검색할 때 사용합니다.

created_from.description:
상품 생성일 범위 시작(검색조건; ISO8601 형식 날짜).

특정 기간 내 등록 상품만 검색할 때 사용합니다.

oneOf.description:
상품 생성일 범위 끝(ISO8601 날짜).

created_from와 함께 기간 검색 조건으로 활용됩니다.

created_to.description:
상품 생성일 범위 끝(ISO8601 날짜).

created_from와 함께 기간 검색 조건으로 활용됩니다.

page.description:
페이지 인덱스(1-base).

AI 커머스 플랫폼에서 카탈로그/검색 결과의 페이징 처리를 담당합니다.

oneOf.description:
페이지 당 결과 수.

대량 데이터셋의 효율적 조회를 위해 적용되는 페이지네이션 컨트롤입니다.

limit.description:
페이지 당 결과 수.

대량 데이터셋의 효율적 조회를 위해 적용되는 페이지네이션 컨트롤입니다.

oneOf.description:
정렬 기준(예: 'created_at_desc', 'title_asc').

UI 및 관리툴, API 클라이언트에서 정렬방식 지정시 사용됩니다.

sort.description:
정렬 기준(예: 'created_at_desc', 'title_asc').

UI 및 관리툴, API 클라이언트에서 정렬방식 지정시 사용됩니다.

IAiEcommerceProduct.IRequest.description:
제품(상품) 목록, 카탈로그 등의 리스트 요청/검색 조건 스키마.

Prisma ai_ecommerce_products 테이블의 조건 복합 검색 및 페이징 요청에서 입력 파라미터로 활용됩니다.

IPageIAiEcommerceProduct.description:
페이지네이션 처리된 ai_ecommerce_product 정보 목록을 포함하는 컨테이너 타입입니다.

이 타입은 상품 조회, 검색 결과, 관리자 카탈로그 관리 등 여러 API에서 사용되며, 각 상품 오브젝트는 IAiEcommerceProduct로 상세 정의되어 있습니다. pagination 필드는 현재 페이지, 총 개수 등의 정보를 포함하고 있습니다.

id.description: 상품 엔티티의 유니크 식별자(UUID). ai_ecommerce_product 테이블의 PK/비즈니스 주요 참조 키입니다.

seller_id.description: 해당 상품을 소유한 판매자의 UUID(외래키). 카탈로그 관리 및 RBAC를 위한 참조 필드입니다.

title.description: 상품명(표시명). 셀러별로 유니크해야 하며, 멀티랭귀지 필드는 별도 미디어 테이블에서 관리됩니다.

description.description: 상품의 상세 설명 텍스트입니다. 본문은 리치 텍스트/마크다운이 허용될 수 있으며, 세부 카피는 ai_ecommerce_media 등 참조로 분리합니다.

status.description: 상품의 카탈로그/라이프사이클 상태(예: draft, published, pending, archived 등).

approval_state.description: 상품의 승인/컴플라이언스 스테이터스(예: pending, approved, rejected 등).

created_at.description: 생성 일시. 상품 등록/감사의 주요 기준.

updated_at.description: 마지막 수정 일시. 변경 이력 트래킹 용.

oneOf.description: 소프트 삭제시 타임스탬프. null이면 정상/존재 상태임.
소프트 삭제시 타임스탬프. null이면 정상/존재 상태임.

deleted_at.description: 소프트 삭제시 타임스탬프. null이면 정상/존재 상태임.

IAiEcommerceProduct.description:
상품 엔티티를 나타내는 오브젝트 타입입니다.

이 타입은 ai_ecommerce_product DB 테이블 내 개별 행(row)을 나타내며, 상품 등록, 검색, 상세 조회, 변경 등 API 응답/요청에서 기본 구조로 사용됩니다. 각 필드는 상품의 비즈니스 상태, 승인 및 생명주기, 그리고 감사/컴플라이언스 관리를 위한 데이터를 제공합니다.

seller_id.description: 상품 등록할 셀러의 UUID(필수, FK).

description.description: 상품 설명 텍스트.

status.description: 상품의 초기 상태(예: draft/pending 등).

approval_state.description: 등록 시점 승인 상태(기본: pending 등).

IAiEcommerceProduct.ICreate.description:
신규 상품 등록 요청에 사용하는 오브젝트 구조입니다.

이 타입은 POST /aiEcommerce/products 등 API에서 request body로 사용되며, 상품 등록 시 반드시 필요한 데이터만 기술되어 있습니다. 상품 ID/타임스탬프 등은 서버 생성이므로 요청 시 입력받지 않습니다.

description.description: 수정할 상품 설명.

status.description: 카탈로그 상태(예: draft, published 등으로 변경 시).

approval_state.description: 승인/심사 상태(예: pending, approved, rejected 등).

IAiEcommerceProduct.IUpdate.description:
기존 상품의 수정에 사용되는 업데이트 오브젝트입니다.

수정 가능한 필드만 포함되며, 요청 시 필요한 필드만 전달하면 부분업데이트가 가능합니다. PATCH/PUT /aiEcommerce/products/{id} 등에서 사용.

id.description: 삭제된 상품의 UUID

deleted_at.description: 소프트삭제 처리된 시점 ISO timestamp

status.description: 삭제 작업 결과(예: 'deleted', 'not-found', 'forbidden' 등).

IAiEcommerceProduct.IDeleteResponse.description:
상품 삭제(소프트 삭제) API 응답에서 반환되는 결과 객체입니다.

삭제된 상품의 식별자와 실제 삭제 처리 시간, 상태 텍스트가 포함됩니다. 감사/컴플라이언스 용도로 활용될 수 있습니다.

product_id.description: 검색 대상이 되는 상품의 UUID.

limit.description: 페이지당 결과 개수.

IAiEcommerceSku.IRequest.description:
SKU 검색/리스트 API에서 필터링, 페이징, 정렬을 위해 사용하는 요청 바디 타입입니다.

프런트엔드에서 상세 검색, 가격대, 코드 등 다중 필터 및 페이지네이션이 요구될 때 활용합니다.

IPageIAiEcommerceSku.description:
페이지네이션이 적용된 SKU(상품 옵션/배리에이션) 결과 리스트입니다.

페이징 및 SKU 목록, 추가 메타 정보(필요시)로 구성되어 있습니다. 관리자/판매자 SKU 관리, 상품 옵션 조회 등에서 사용합니다.

id.description: SKU 고유 식별자(PK).

product_id.description: 소속 상품의 UUID(FK).

created_at.description: SKU 생성시간(감사, 등록이력).

updated_at.description: 마지막 수정/업데이트 시간.

IAiEcommerceSku.description:
SKU(재고단위, 배리에이션) 엔티티의 전체 스키마입니다.

ai_ecommerce_skus DB 테이블 행을 그대로 맵핑하며, 상품 옵션/배리에이션, 가격/재고 분류, 카탈로그 관리 등의 API에서 사용됩니다.

product_id.description: SKU가 속한 상품의 UUID(FK).

is_active.description: 판매 활성화 여부. 신규 등록 시 True/False 지정.

aiEcommerceSkus.ICreate.description:
SKU 새 등록에 대한 요청 바디 타입입니다.

상품 등록/옵션 추가, 각종 배리에이션 생성 시 사용됩니다. 필수 항목만 작성합니다. 생성시 id, 생성일시 등은 서버 시스템에서 정의됩니다.

id.description: SKU 식별자(PK).

product_id.description: 소속 상품 UUID(FK).

created_at.description: 생성시각.

updated_at.description: 마지막 수정 시각.

aiEcommerceSkus.description:
SKU 단위 개체의 전체 DB필드와 동일한 반환/요청 사양입니다.

상세 내용은 ai_ecommerce_skus 참조. 카탈로그, 재고, 옵션화면 등에서 표준 레코드로 사용합니다.

code.description: 변경할 SKU 코드(상품 내 유니크 유지).

aiEcommerceSkus.IUpdate.description:

IPageAiEcommerceCategories.description:
A paginated list of ai_ecommerce_categories records, including metadata for pagination, result set, and total record count. Used for listing category resources according to ProductCatalog domain requirements and OpenAPI operation outputs.

References standard Page object structure per IPage<T>, and is concrete for the category resource. Ensures compliance with OpenAPI requirements for named reference types and supports consistent handling by client code.

pagination.description: Pagination metadata for the result set according to IPage structure. This object includes current page, limit, total records, and total pages.

data.description: An array of ai_ecommerce_categories objects representing the records returned for this page.

aiEcommerceCategories.description:
Product category entity as defined in the ai_ecommerce_categories Prisma schema.

Represents a category for products, supporting hierarchical (parent/child) relationships, textual description, and audit fields for creation/update tracking. Used for catalog navigation, search, and classification across the product catalog.

Fulfills requirements in Product Management and the ERD. Keys include id, name, parent_id (for category tree), description, created_at, updated_at.

id.description: Unique identifier for this category. Matches Prisma schema PK.

oneOf.description: Optional UUID for parent category, supports category hierarchy. Null if this is a root category.
Optional UUID for parent category, supports category hierarchy. Null if this is a root category.

parent_id.description: Optional UUID for parent category, supports category hierarchy. Null if this is a root category.

name.description: Display name for the category (must be unique under the same parent).

description.description: Human-readable description of the category (e.g., business line, navigation hint).

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp for when the category record was created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp for when the category was last updated.

aiEcommerceCategories.ICreate.description:
Request object for creating a new product category in ai_ecommerce_categories.

Fulfills the OpenAPI operation body definition for category creation. Input fields mirror the schema, required for creation: name, description, optional parent_id for hierarchy.

oneOf.description: Optionally specify a parent category's id for building hierarchies. Null if root.
Optionally specify a parent category's id for building hierarchies. Null if root.

parent_id.description: Optionally specify a parent category's id for building hierarchies. Null if root.

name.description: Name for the new category (required, must be unique under parent).

description.description: Description for the new category (required).

aiEcommerceCategories.IUpdate.description:
Request object for updating an existing product category in ai_ecommerce_categories by id.

Enables updating a category's name, parent_id or description according to business rules. Must follow the constraints for uniqueness and hierarchy as per the Prisma schema.

oneOf.description: Optionally update the parent category (uuid) to change hierarchy, or set to null for root.
Optionally update the parent category (uuid) to change hierarchy, or set to null for root.

parent_id.description: Optionally update the parent category (uuid) to change hierarchy, or set to null for root.

name.description: Name of the category (must be unique under parent, optional in update but required if changing).

description.description: Category description (optional in update but required if changing).

aiEcommerceInventories.IRequest.description:
Request body for searching, filtering, and paginating ai_ecommerce_inventories records. Used in list API endpoints for inventories in the ProductCatalog domain.

Fields allow for search by sku_id, location, minimum or maximum quantities, and pagination/sort controls according to standard API patterns.

oneOf.description: Optionally filter by inventory belonging to a specific SKU.
Optionally filter by inventory belonging to a specific SKU.

sku_id.description: Optionally filter by inventory belonging to a specific SKU.

oneOf.description: Filter inventory records by location string (e.g., warehouse or fulfillment center code). May be null to match any location.
Filter inventory records by location string (e.g., warehouse or fulfillment center code). May be null to match any location.

location.description: Filter inventory records by location string (e.g., warehouse or fulfillment center code). May be null to match any location.

oneOf.description: Optionally filter for inventory records where quantity_available is at least this value.
Optionally filter for inventory records where quantity_available is at least this value.

min_quantity_available.description: Optionally filter for inventory records where quantity_available is at least this value.

oneOf.description: Optionally filter for inventory records where quantity_available is no more than this value.
Optionally filter for inventory records where quantity_available is no more than this value.

max_quantity_available.description: Optionally filter for inventory records where quantity_available is no more than this value.

oneOf.description: Page number for results (optional, pagination).
Page number for results (optional, pagination).
Limit number of records per page (optional, default as per service implementation).
Limit number of records per page (optional, default as per service implementation).

limit.description: Limit number of records per page (optional, default as per service implementation).

IPageAiEcommerceInventories.description:
Paginated list of ai_ecommerce_inventories records, including pagination metadata per IPage<T>.

Used for API endpoints returning multiple inventory records, conforming to OpenAPI referenced-component requirements for named schemas.

pagination.description: Pagination metadata object per IPage standard.

data.description: Array of inventory records for this page.

aiEcommerceInventories.description:
Atomic inventory record as defined in the ai_ecommerce_inventories Prisma table.

Each record is a unique stock availability snapshot for a given SKU and location, tracking available quantities, reserved units, and audit fields for full traceability.

This entity supports all inventory search/list APIs and maps to the inventory management feature set outlined in Product Management.

id.description: Inventory record unique identifier (UUID PK).

sku_id.description: SKU UUID this inventory row is for.

location.description: Location string for warehouse, fulfillment center, etc.

quantity_available.description: Atomic count of units available for sale (not reserved or in orders).

quantity_reserved.description: Quantity that is reserved (e.g., allocated in orders, not yet fulfilled).

created_at.description: Timestamp for inventory row creation (ISO 8601 format).

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this inventory was last updated.

aiEcommerceInventories.ICreate.description:
Request object for creating new ai_ecommerce_inventories records through the inventory API.

All required fields for a new inventory: sku_id, location, initial available/reserved quantity. Ensures proper construction for API POST endpoints.

sku_id.description: Foreign key UUID of the SKU the inventory belongs to (required).

location.description: Location (warehouse code or name) for this stock row (required).

quantity_reserved.description: Initial reserved quantity (required, typically zero at creation unless concurrent allocations exist).

aiEcommerceInventories.IUpdate.description:
Request object for updating an existing ai_ecommerce_inventories row via API.

Allows updates to mutable fields: location, available/reserved counts (e.g., for correction, fulfillment, or warehouse transfers).

location.description: New value for warehouse/stock location (optional in update).

quantity_available.description: Set new value for available units (optional field in update).

quantity_reserved.description: Set new value for reserved units (optional field in update).

aiEcommerceMedia.IRequest.description: Request object for searching and listing product, SKU, or category media assets (images, videos, etc). Used for advanced pagination/filter/search APIs against ai_ecommerce_media table records.

oneOf.description: Filter for the owner type (product, sku, category).
Filter for the owner type (product, sku, category).

owner_type.description: Filter for the owner type (product, sku, category).

oneOf.description: Filter by owner id (product/sku/category UUID).
Filter by owner id (product/sku/category UUID).
Filter by MIME media type (e.g., image/png, video/mp4).
Filter by MIME media type (e.g., image/png, video/mp4).

media_type.description: Filter by MIME media type (e.g., image/png, video/mp4).

oneOf.description: Optional filter for language tag in media (e.g., 'en', 'ko').
Optional filter for language tag in media (e.g., 'en', 'ko').

language.description: Optional filter for language tag in media (e.g., 'en', 'ko').

oneOf.description: Page number for paginated results.
Page number for paginated results.
Results per page (limit for pagination).
Results per page (limit for pagination).

limit.description: Results per page (limit for pagination).

oneOf.description: Optional search value for fuzzy match in URI or meta fields.
Optional search value for fuzzy match in URI or meta fields.

search_text.description: Optional search value for fuzzy match in URI or meta fields.

aiEcommerceMedia.IPage.description: Paginated array of media asset records, used for list/search endpoints on ai_ecommerce_media table.

pagination.description: Pagination metadata for result set.

data.description: Array of media records for this page.

aiEcommerceMedia.description:
Atomic media asset record for product, SKU, or category; as described in ai_ecommerce_media Prisma schema.

Each record represents an attached file or URI for rich catalog rendering, tracking owner, type, URI, localization, and creation metadata.

id.description: Media asset unique identifier (UUID PK).

owner_id.description: Referenced PK (UUID) for owner resource (product, sku, category etc).

owner_type.description: String discriminating media owner type (product, sku, category).

uri.description: Location (file, CDN, or cloud URI) for the media asset.

oneOf.description: Optional ISO language code for localization (null if not localized for this record).
Optional ISO language code for localization (null if not localized for this record).

language.description: Optional ISO language code for localization (null if not localized for this record).

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when media record was registered.

owner_id.description:
The UUID of the entity that owns this media (product, SKU, or category).

Reference to either a product, SKU, or category record, according to `owner_type`.

owner_type.description:
An explicit discriminator indicating which type of entity is the owner ('product', 'sku', or 'category').

This is required in order to distinguish which business entity the file is attached to.

uri.description: URL or URI to storage/cdn/file location for registered media asset (e.g., https://cdn.example.com/img.jpg). Can be 1-80000 characters.

media_type.description: Mimetype/format of file, e.g. 'image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'video/mp4'. Strictly atomic, non-aggregated.

oneOf.description: Optional ISO language code (e.g. 'ko','en'). Null allowed for non-multilingual or nonlocalized media.
Optional ISO language code (e.g. 'ko','en'). Null allowed for non-multilingual or nonlocalized media.

language.description: Optional ISO language code (e.g. 'ko','en'). Null allowed for non-multilingual or nonlocalized media.

aiEcommerceMedia.ICreate.description: Creation schema for product, SKU, or category media asset in ai_ecommerce_media. Attach new image, video, or document to a catalog entity. Maps strictly to schema and documentation requirements. Used for POST /aiEcommerce/media. Enforces references and atomic normalized design.

owner_id.description: The UUID of the entity that will own the media asset after the update. Optional if not changing ownership.

owner_type.description: Type of the owning entity ('product', 'sku', 'category'). Optional if not changing. If present, must match an allowed type.

uri.description: URI for the file location. May be updated if file changes. Required for reference integrity and access.

media_type.description: Mimetype (e.g., image/jpeg, video/mp4). Update if file type changes.

oneOf.description: ISO code or null; localization update.
ISO code or null; localization update.

language.description: ISO code or null; localization update.

aiEcommerceMedia.IUpdate.description: Update schema for a media asset in ai_ecommerce_media. Allows updating media URI/location, file type, owner entity, or language. Fields are optional but at least one must be provided. Used for PUT on /aiEcommerce/media/{id}. Enforces normalization and audit requirements.

product_id.description: Optionally filter by parent product ID. When provided, limits results to options belonging to a specific product.

oneOf.description: Optionally filter by SKU ID. Results are constrained to options for a given SKU when set (or null to find product-level only).
Optionally filter by SKU ID. Results are constrained to options for a given SKU when set (or null to find product-level only).

sku_id.description: Optionally filter by SKU ID. Results are constrained to options for a given SKU when set (or null to find product-level only).

limit.description: Pagination: records per page. Default 20, maximum 100.

sort_field.description: Name of field to sort by, e.g. 'option_name', 'created_at'. Must be valid field.

oneOf.description: Sort direction. 'asc' for ascending, 'desc' for descending.
Sort direction. 'asc' for ascending, 'desc' for descending.

sort_order.description: Sort direction. 'asc' for ascending, 'desc' for descending.

aiEcommerceProductOption.IRequest.description: Schema for requesting paginated/searchable product option listing/results. Supports advanced filtering and paging for PATCH on /aiEcommerce/productOptions. Queries all options (e.g., colors, sizes, attributes) by product/SKU context, name/value, and paginates per request. Follows full normalization rules.

data.description: List of product option records returned in this page.

aiEcommerceProductOption.IPage.description: Paginated result set for product option list/search operations. Each page has standard pagination and normalized product option array.

id.description: Primary key (UUID) for option row. Unique identifier for this specific product/option row.

product_id.description: The parent product to which this option belongs. Must be an existing product UUID.

oneOf.description: Optionally, this option's value is specific to a certain SKU. Null if option is product-level, UUID if tied to a variation/SKU.
Optionally, this option's value is specific to a certain SKU. Null if option is product-level, UUID if tied to a variation/SKU.

sku_id.description: Optionally, this option's value is specific to a certain SKU. Null if option is product-level, UUID if tied to a variation/SKU.

option_name.description: Option name (e.g., color, size, material). String label; max length per DB constraints.

option_value.description: Value for this option (e.g., 'red', 'L', 'cotton'). String value matching field constraints.

created_at.description: Atomic timestamp when this option was created.

aiEcommerceProductOption.description: Atomic normalized product option row for ai_ecommerce_product_option. Maps to a single option value (e.g., Color=Red for one product/SKU). Used in SKU configurators and for advanced search/analytics.

product_id.description: UUID of the parent product for which the option is being registered.

oneOf.description: Optional UUID if option to be attached to a specific SKU, null means applies at product level.
Optional UUID if option to be attached to a specific SKU, null means applies at product level.

sku_id.description: Optional UUID if option to be attached to a specific SKU, null means applies at product level.

option_name.description: Option name (normalized, e.g. 'color', 'size', 'material'). Must be atomic and valid per DB rules.

option_value.description: Value to assign for this option (e.g., 'red', 'XL', 'cotton').

aiEcommerceProductOption.ICreate.description: Creation schema for product/sku option row, maps to ai_ecommerce_product_option. Used to register new configurable attributes during product onboarding or catalog augmentation. IC for POST /aiEcommerce/productOptions.

option_name.description: Update the option name (e.g., to correct/normalize attribute key).

option_value.description: Update the value for this option.

oneOf.description: Update SKU association (UUID if changing to a SKU option, or null to rebase as product-level only).
Update SKU association (UUID if changing to a SKU option, or null to rebase as product-level only).

sku_id.description: Update SKU association (UUID if changing to a SKU option, or null to rebase as product-level only).

aiEcommerceProductOption.IUpdate.description: Update schema for ai_ecommerce_product_option, allows changing name/value/SKU association. For PUT /aiEcommerce/productOptions/{id} operations. Each field is optional and may be updated individually.

rule_name.description: Filter by canonical rule name (case-insensitive substring search or exact per implementation).

description.description: Filter by rule description or keyword (case-insensitive).

created_before.description: Find rules created before this ISO 8601 timestamp.

created_after.description: Find rules created after this ISO 8601 timestamp.

limit.description: Records per page returned; 1-100 allowed.

aiEcommerceProductComplianceRule.IReques.description: Request schema for paginated, advanced/filtered search of product compliance rules. Used in PATCH on /aiEcommerce/productComplianceRules. Allows admins to search catalog for regulatory/business rules (e.g., 'No Sale Under 18', 'EN71 Certified') by name, description, or created_at window.

data.description: The compliance rule records included in this page.

aiEcommerceProductComplianceRule.IPage.description: Paginated set of product compliance rule records, for admin/catalog workflows. Used in PATCH /aiEcommerce/productComplianceRules. Pagination follows platform IPage contracts.

id.description: Primary key (UUID) of compliance rule record.

rule_name.description: Canonical descriptive rule name (e.g., 'No Sale Under 18'). Must be human-readable and unique; required for admin/UX and regulatory clarity.

description.description: Details or explanation of compliance rule for audit/legal/business clarity. Multi-paragraph text allowed.

created_at.description: Creation timestamp for record; enables audit and compliance trail.

IAiEcommerceProductComplianceRule.description: Canonical product compliance rule definition entity row (ai_ecommerce_product_compliance_rules). Describes safety/legal requirement enforced by admin for products. Used in onboarding/audit workflows. For detail endpoints and paging lists.

rule_name.description: Canonical name of the rule to create (must be unique across all compliance rules). Important for business, audit, and UX scenarios.

description.description: Detailed human- and regulator-facing explanation of rule. Should capture all requirements for compliance as text.

IAiEcommerceProductComplianceRule.ICreat.description: Creation contract for new product compliance rule. Used in POST /aiEcommerce/productComplianceRules. Ensures all business and audit fields are present for downstream workflows.

rule_name.description: Rule name. Can be updated; must remain unique.

description.description: Compliance rule details (multi-paragraph allowed).

IAiEcommerceProductComplianceRule.IUpdat.description: Update schema for existing product compliance rule. Allows changes to rule name and description; both fields are optional.

success.description:
호출 작업의 성공 여부를 나타냅니다.

true이면 작업이 성공적으로 완료되었음을 의미하며, false는 오류 또는 실패를 의미합니다.

message.description:
작업 결과에 대한 설명 또는 사용자에게 보여줄 메시지입니다.

성공 시 간결한 안내 메시지, 실패 시 상세 오류 정보를 포함할 수 있습니다.

IOperationResult.description:
특정 작업(예: 삭제, 활성화, 비활성화 등) 수행 결과를 반환하는 표준 API 응답 오브젝트입니다.

success 필드는 작업 성공/실패 여부를 나타내며, 필요에 따라 message 필드에 상세 메타 정보를 제공합니다.

이 타입은 간결한 상태 응답이 필요한 DELETE, Soft-delete, 상태변경 등 컨트롤 계열 API에서 일관적으로 사용됩니다.

page.description:
페이지 번호(1부터 시작). 기본값은 1.

상품 태그 목록 조회(검색, 필터링, 페이지네이션)에 사용되는 요청 객체 타입입니다.

pagination.description:

총 페이지 수, 전체 건수, 현재 페이지, 페이지당 건수 등의 정보를 포함함.

data.description: 현재 페이지에 포함된 상품 태그 요약 리스트입니다.

IPageIAiEcommerceProductTag.description:
상품 태그 목록 리스트 및 페이지네이션 정보를 함께 제공하는 컨테이너 타입.

테이블 뷰, 검색 결과 등에서 일괄적으로 활용됩니다.

id.description: 상품 태그의 고유 식별자(UUID)입니다.

name.description:

IAiEcommerceProductTag.description:

유일 식별자, 태그명, 생성 시각 등으로 구성됩니다.

name.description:

IAiEcommerceProductTag.ICreate.description:

name이 유일해야 하며, 이름 규칙은 서비스 정책에 따릅니다.

pagination.description:
Pagination information for the current page of reviews.

References the standard IPage.IPagination schema used for all paginated records in the platform. Includes current page, page size, total records, and page count.

Critical for user interfaces and API clients to present paginated data.

Each entry references complete IAiEcommerceReview schema, including product, customer, body, and rating info as defined in the DB and business requirements. Not a summary—contains all properties needed for detail display.

Implements pagination wrapper pattern according to the IPage<T> interface. Contains a list of review records for the current result window, and pagination metadata for navigation. Used in review listing APIs throughout the commerce platform. Follows IPage documentation from platform architecture.

id.description:
Primary key for the review entity. System-generated globally unique identifier according to Prisma schema 'id'.

Used for all API access, update, and linkage to comments/replies/analytics.
Critical for auditability and traceability.

customer_id.description:
Foreign key referencing the ai_ecommerce_customer who authored this review.

Required for all access control, display, and integrity verification.
Enforces normalized identity via strict foreign key linkage.

product_id.description:
Foreign key referencing the ai_ecommerce_product being reviewed. Connects each review to its catalog target.

Used in all queries for product detail, aggregation, or analytics. Strict referential integrity.

order_id.description:
Order FK referencing the ai_ecommerce_order through which the product was purchased, to enforce verified review requirement as in requirements analysis.

Allows KYC audit, post-purchase flows, and moderation of review legitimacy.

rating.description:
Star rating given to the product by the customer.

Represents normalized rating scale (typically 1-5), enforced by validation service logic. Used for analytics, display, and review sort/rank business rules.

Optional review title/headline for richer content and SEO.

String or null as in Prisma schema. If present, shown as headline in UI; otherwise omitted by clients.

Set to true when system confirms the customer purchased product. Used to filter and sort reviews in compliance/SEO.

is_private.description:

IAiEcommerceReview.description:
Product review entity from ai_ecommerce_review table.

Implements detailed data structure for user-generated product reviews according to 'ai_ecommerce_review' schema and requirements for product review, feedback, moderation, audit, rollback, and personalization.

Includes all major atomic properties: PK, author, product, associated order, rating integer, optional headline/title, review text, privacy status, created/updated audit timestamps, and soft-deletion status. Review entity enables e-commerce and community workflows as required by 2025 AI-powered shopping platforms.

customer_id.description:
Customer FK for review authoring – must match logged-in or authenticated user. References ai_ecommerce_customer table.

Required on POST.

product_id.description:
Product FK being reviewed – normalized to ai_ecommerce_product table.

Required to establish review context and KYC.

order_id.description: Order FK – required for purchase verification. Must link to order for 'verified' flag as per schema.

rating.description: Integer star rating (typically 1-5), validated by business logic.

Headline/title for the review (optional, may be null).
If omitted, review is body-only.

If omitted, review is body-only.

title.description:
Headline/title for the review (optional, may be null).
If omitted, review is body-only.

body.description:
Main body text of review (required).
String content as per UGC requirements.

Privacy flag for this review – true if review is only visible to involved users/admin/mod/seller.
Set according to UI/user intent.

IPageIAiEcommercePayment.description:
Paginated result object for listing payment transaction records in the AI E-Commerce system (ai_ecommerce_payment).

The data array contains payment transaction objects, while the pagination object details current page, total records, and page count for efficient client navigation and result management. This structure is standard across all paginated resource endpoints.

It references the IAiEcommercePayment type for each transaction entry and follows the platform's result set interface design.

id.description:
Unique identifier of the payment transaction. Generated by the system and serves as the primary record key for referencing and auditing.

Referenced from order, wallet transaction, and analytics entities. UUID format for uniqueness and traceability.

amount.description:
Atomic payment amount. Represents the monetary value of this transaction in the specified currency. No derived/calculated/aggregate values are used.

Examples include order purchase amounts, deposit/recharge entries, and refund totals.

provider.description:
Payment provider name, such as 'stripe', 'toss', 'paypal', etc. This string distinguishes among integrated payment gateway or provider systems.

Required for validation, reporting, and audit context. Not nullable or blank.

method.description:
Specific method or channel of payment, such as 'credit_card', 'bank_transfer', or 'mobile'. Used for analytics, reporting, and user portal display.

This field is atomic, consistent with the provider's supported method taxonomy.

oneOf.description:
External payment processor-provided transaction code, if available. Nullable—may not be present for all integrations.

Used for reconciliation, refunds, and customer support scenarios. Must be unique across all records if supplied.

External payment processor-provided transaction code, if available. Nullable—may not be present for all integrations.

Used for reconciliation, refunds, and customer support scenarios. Must be unique across all records if supplied.

payment_reference.description:
External payment processor-provided transaction code, if available. Nullable—may not be present for all integrations.

Used for reconciliation, refunds, and customer support scenarios. Must be unique across all records if supplied.

status.description:
Current status of the payment transaction (e.g., 'pending', 'completed', 'failed', 'cancelled'). Workflow and state machine for payments track progress via this column.

Key for error handling, support, and customer notification workflows.

created_at.description: Timestamp for when the payment transaction was created or initiated. ISO 8601 UTC format. Used for audit and transactional sequencing.

updated_at.description:
Timestamp for most recent update to the payment transaction. Also in ISO 8601 UTC format.

Tracks status updates, reconciliation, or manual corrections. For audit/compliance retention.

IAiEcommercePayment.description:
Atomic payment transaction object representing a single event in the commerce/payment system (ai_ecommerce_payment).

Fields include monetary amount, provider/method metadata, reconciliation references, and audit status and timestamps. Fully normalized and suitable for compliance, reporting, and transactional consistency. Related to IAiEcommercePayment.ICreate and .IUpdate for lifecycle operations.

amount.description:
Atomic payment amount for the new transaction to be created. Must be a positive decimal value; matches intended charge/refund in the given currency.

No aggregates—property is atomic in the schema.

provider.description: Payment provider name (e.g., 'stripe', 'paypal', 'toss', etc). Required for payment integration resolution, audit, and downstream workflow.

method.description: Payment method/channel used for the transaction. Examples: 'credit_card', 'bank_transfer', 'mobile', etc.

oneOf.description: Reference ID or transaction code from the provider for this payment. Nullable; if present, must be unique across all payment entities. Used for reconciliation/troubleshooting.
Reference ID or transaction code from the provider for this payment. Nullable; if present, must be unique across all payment entities. Used for reconciliation/troubleshooting.

payment_reference.description: Reference ID or transaction code from the provider for this payment. Nullable; if present, must be unique across all payment entities. Used for reconciliation/troubleshooting.

Fields must include amount, provider, method, status, and optionally a provider/external reference for reconciliation. Used as input for creation endpoint, separate from audit-only fields (id/timestamps assigned by system).

Updated status for the payment event (e.g., 'completed', 'failed', 'refunded'), as permitted by business workflow. Required for semantic state transitions.

May be subject to validation depending on prior state and business rules.

Corrected or reconciled provider reference ID for this payment. May be updated to resolve reconciliation errors or processor detail updates.

payment_reference.description: Corrected or reconciled provider reference ID for this payment. May be updated to resolve reconciliation errors or processor detail updates.

IaiEcommerceWallet.description:
Digital wallet entity for customer balances, deposits, payments, and refunds.

Represents a strictly normalized, account-based wallet record within the AI-powered e-commerce system. Each wallet is associated with a single customer, currency, and lifecycle state. Records are used for in-system transactions, wallet-to-wallet transfers, and as the accounting basis for payment/refund reconciliation. Origin: ai_ecommerce_wallet table.

customer_id.description:
Owning customer UUID for this wallet. Must reference a valid ai_ecommerce_customer record.

Required for wallet onboarding, cannot be null.

currency_code.description: ISO 4217 currency code (e.g., "KRW", "USD") for this wallet instance. Only one wallet per (customer, currency) is permitted.

is_active.description: Flag indicating if the wallet should be immediately available for use (true) or locked (false).

IaiEcommerceWallet.ICreate.description:
Request schema for creating a new digital wallet.

Supplies customer linkage and currency designation as required for wallet instantiation. Is used by onboarding flows, support/accounting tools, and customer-initiated wallet creation. Origin: ai_ecommerce_wallet creation API.

is_active.description:
Updates the activation status of the wallet.

Use to lock, freeze, or reactivate a wallet for compliance or dispute resolution.

transaction_type.description: Textual event code: e.g., "deposit", "payment", "refund", as required by schemas & APIs.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the transaction occurred. ISO 8601/RFC 3339 format.

Atomic transaction log record for digital wallet inflow/outflow.

Defines a strictly normalized account event, including wallet, amount, references, transaction type, and timestamp. Used for payment, refund, deposit, and audit flows.

Must reference a valid digital wallet and customer. FK to ai_ecommerce_wallet.id.

order_id.description:

Nullable, required when the transaction is order-triggered.

Nullable.

Unique identifier for the payment integration record.

Primary key in ai_ecommerce_payment_integration.
