Name of the payment provider/gateway (e.g., 'Stripe', 'KCP', 'KakaoPay').

Enforces uniqueness per integration.

configuration_json.description:
JSON-serialized settings and credentials for payment API integration.

Typically includes endpoint, API keys, credentials, etc.; sensitive information should be masked in public API.

is_active.description:
True if the payment integration is available/enabled in the platform; false if disabled or archived.

Reflects whether provider is currently in use for checkout processes.

created_at.description:
Timestamp of configuration creation/last update.

For audit and operational monitoring.

IAiEcommercePaymentIntegration.description:
Payment integration configuration entity for external gateway providers.

Configures how the commerce platform interfaces with external payment gateways. Contains serialized settings and activation status for system operations. Used in payment, refund, and checkout management workflows.

Origin: ai_ecommerce_payment_integration table.

provider_name.description:
Payment provider's name to register. Unique identifier across payment provider types. Example: 'Stripe', 'KakaoPay', 'PayPal'.
This is required for identifying payment gateways when creating or updating payment integration records, as described in the ai_ecommerce_payment_integration table.

From compliance and business perspective, it's important the value reflects the actual legal or brand identifier and complies with uniqueness constraints at the business level.

configuration_json.description:
Configuration JSON (typically a string blob of encrypted/encoded parameters) for the payment integration. Example: '{"api_key":"...."}'
This field enables secure credential and setup data storage, as required for third-party gateway onboarding and maintenance. Must be a well-formed JSON string.

Only system administrators are allowed to set this, and validation should occur upstream to ensure compliance and security standards.

is_active.description:
Flag to indicate if this payment integration is currently enabled for use on the platform. Example: true
This supports compliance requirements for inactive/maintenance/offboarding states for payment integrations.

Changing this value may result in immediate operational changes to the allowed payment flows and should be used with care.

IAiEcommercePaymentIntegration.ICreate.description:
Request body structure for creating a payment integration record (ai_ecommerce_payment_integration).

Fulfills requirements from the Discount, Loyalty & Payment System Plan. Must reference provider_name (unique), configuration_json (valid JSON), and is_active flag for gateway enablement.

The object must contain all fields for compliance, including the secure configuration data according to the platform's security policies.

provider_name.description:
(Optional) Change payment provider's name. If set, must remain unique and consistent with existing business naming conventions.

If updating, applies to the legal or display identifier for this payment integration on the platform.

From a compliance standpoint, this should rarely be changed; if so, must not overlap with any current provider_name in ai_ecommerce_payment_integration.

configuration_json.description:
(Optional) Update the payment configuration JSON for the integration record. String value (must be valid JSON if present), typically includes API credentials, secrets, or setup data for the gateway provider.

Must adhere to platform security requirements and encryption standards. All updates should be audit-logged for credential changes.

is_active.description:
(Optional) Toggle for enabling/disabling this payment integration record. Setting to false may disable all payment flows through this provider until re-enabled.

Security and compliance logs must record changes to this field for regulatory reasons.

IAiEcommercePaymentIntegration.IUpdate.description:
Request body for updating a payment integration record (ai_ecommerce_payment_integration).

All properties are optional, allowing for partial updates. Any field supplied must pass validation as per creation constraints. No property is required to be supplied, but at least one should be present for a meaningful update operation.

Changes are always subject to audit logging as required by payment compliance standards.

deleted_id.description:
UUID of the payment integration that was deleted.

Returned as confirmation for deletion operations, traceable in audit logs.

IAiEcommercePaymentIntegration.IDelete.description: Response schema for confirming successful deletion of a payment integration record. Includes only the unique identifier of the deleted entry for audit and tracking purposes.

rule_type.description:
Filter for discount rule type. Example: 'fixed_amount', 'percentage', 'stacking'.
Accepts a specific rule type for list/search/filtering of discount rules.

description_query.description:
Search or filter by (partial) description field. Example: 'holiday', 'member tier', 'order total'.
Used as a query string for description field filtering.

oneOf.description:
Sorting order, 'asc' for ascending, 'desc' for descending based on created timestamp or sortable key.
Only allows these two enum values by business rule.

Sorting order, 'asc' for ascending, 'desc' for descending based on created timestamp or sortable key.
Only allows these two enum values by business rule.

sort_order.description:
Sorting order, 'asc' for ascending, 'desc' for descending based on created timestamp or sortable key.
Only allows these two enum values by business rule.

page.description: Result page number (pagination control). Must be a positive integer (>=1).

per_page.description: Page size for pagination (limit on results per page). Must be a positive integer (e.g., 10, 20, 50, 100).

IAiEcommerceDiscountRule.IRequest.description:
Request schema for searching, filtering, or paginating discount rules (ai_ecommerce_discount_rule).

All fields are optional; combining multiple fields enables refined searches for administrative, seller, or analytics review scenarios.

Pagination and sorting ensures manageable and consistent result sets for UI and batch operations.

data.description:
List of discount rule records for this page.
Each item corresponds to a unique discount rule configuration in the system.

IPageAiEcommerceDiscountRule.description:
Paginated result wrapper for ai_ecommerce_discount_rule search/list operations.

Combines page-level metadata (pagination info) and an array of discount rule objects matching filter and search parameters.

Fulfills pattern for IPage<T> as required by the system's API contracts.

id.description:
Unique identifier (UUID) for each discount rule. Serves as the PK in ai_ecommerce_discount_rule.
Immutable and required for all downstream operations.

rule_type.description:
Type indicator for discount logic. Example: 'fixed_amount', 'percentage', 'stacking', etc.
Defines the active logic for coupon or promotion calculation; interpreted by rule engine.
Possible values are controlled at the application layer.

description.description:
A free-text, human-readable description of this rule's purpose. Example: '10% off for VIPs', 'Order >=100,000WKR: 20,000WKR discount.'
This field clarifies business, compliance, or system usage scope of the rule.
Filled per discount campaign or administrative config.

predicate_json.description:
Rule predicate/settings in serialized JSON format. Example: '{"min_order_amount":100000,"applies_to":"all_customers"}'.
Used for flexible, extensible rule evaluation at runtime.

Must be well-formed JSON; actual structure enforced/validated at the service layer.

created_at.description:
Creation timestamp for audit compliance. ISO 8601 format.
Enables sorting, reporting, and regulatory verification.

IAiEcommerceDiscountRule.description:
Represents a single discount rule entity in the AI E-Commerce backend.

Maps 1:1 to a row in ai_ecommerce_discount_rule. All fields are normalized and required for business logic, reporting, and audit compliance workflows.

Contains type, description, flexible predicate JSON for business/rule engine, and metadata.

rule_type.description:
Discount logic type (example: 'fixed_amount', 'percentage', 'stacking').
Must be supported by system rule engine; see compliance docs for allowed values.

description.description: Human description of the discount rule for display, admin, and compliance records. Must be clear to auditors and business users.

predicate_json.description:
Serialized JSON string expressing the predicate/conditions for this rule. Example: '{"min_order_amount":10000, "applies_to":"first_purchase"}'.
Must be valid JSON; format/required fields depend on rule_type.

IAiEcommerceDiscountRule.ICreate.description:
Request body for creating a new discount rule in ai_ecommerce_discount_rule.

Enforces system registration of logic type, user-facing description, and predicate JSON to allow flexible/discoverable rule onboarding for business/campaign use.

rule_type.description: (Optional) Discount logic type - must comply with rule engine's allowed values. Only present if updating rule logic (system must validate transitions, see documentation).

description.description: (Optional) Updated human-readable description for the rule, used for compliance records or correcting display detail.

predicate_json.description: (Optional) Serialized JSON with updated predicate/conditions. Used for logic corrections, eligibility expansion, or campaign re-targeting. Must be well-formed JSON when present.

IAiEcommerceDiscountRule.IUpdate.description:
Request body for updating a discount rule record in ai_ecommerce_discount_rule.

Fields are optional; each updates business/compliance details or conditional logic for the discount rule. When present, values must comply with creation/registration requirements for business rule onboarding.

deleted_id.description:
UUID for the discount rule that was deleted/removed from the system.

Serves as confirmation and audit log/correlation key for deletion events.

IAiEcommerceDiscountRule.IDelete.description:
Response body structure confirming successful deletion of a discount rule by its unique identifier.

Used for tracking and auditing deletion events as required for compliance and operation monitoring.

customer_id.description:
(Optional) Filter: UUID for the customer whose favorites are being queried. Helps restrict results when searching as admin or owner.
Must be a valid UUID if provided.

product_id.description:
(Optional) Filter: UUID of a specific product. Restricts favorites to those for a particular item.
Enables personalized or batch product engagement analytics.

favorite_tag_id.description:
(Optional) Filter: UUID for a tag to group favorites by customer-defined label.
Common usage: retrieving user-favorites within a group (e.g., 'Wish List', 'Holiday Gifts').

created_after.description: (Optional) Limits result to favorites created after this ISO 8601 timestamp. Used for freshness/recency analysis.

created_before.description: (Optional) Limits result to favorites created before this ISO 8601 timestamp. Used for range-limited analytics or clean-up.

oneOf.description:
Sort order for listing favorites (by created date). Ascending ('asc') or descending ('desc').
Only these exact enum values are valid per API.

Sort order for listing favorites (by created date). Ascending ('asc') or descending ('desc').
Only these exact enum values are valid per API.

sort_order.description:
Sort order for listing favorites (by created date). Ascending ('asc') or descending ('desc').
Only these exact enum values are valid per API.

page.description: Result page number for pagination; 1-based indexing. Must be >=1 if present.

per_page.description: Number of favorite records to return per page, for pagination control.

IAiEcommerceFavorite.IRequest.description:
Request schema for searching, filtering, or paging favorite records (ai_ecommerce_favorite). Fields are optional; combining multiple enables precise, personalized or administrative queries for product engagement, campaign analysis, or customer UX features.

Supports filtering by customer/product/tag/created range, sorting, and paging for scalable API responses.

data.description:
The array of favorite records on this page.
Each object represents one customer-product favorite entry.

IPageAiEcommerceFavorite.description:
Paginated wrapper for favorite records, following the IPage<T> pattern.

Contains both paging metadata and the array of ai_ecommerce_favorite entities for current query/context.

id.description:
Primary key for the favorite entry (systemwide UUID).
Links uniquely to a particular (customer_id, product_id) tuple.

customer_id.description:
UUID for the customer who owns this favorite (references ai_ecommerce_customer).
Ensures the favorite entry is not ambiguous among users.

product_id.description:
UUID for the product that has been favorited (references ai_ecommerce_product).
Enables rapid lookup and analytics by product.

oneOf.description: (Optional) UUID for a tag/group with which this favorite is categorized (references ai_ecommerce_favorite_tag). Null if untagged.

favorite_tag_id.description: (Optional) UUID for a tag/group with which this favorite is categorized (references ai_ecommerce_favorite_tag). Null if untagged.

created_at.description: Timestamp in ISO 8601 when the favorite was created. Used for managing recency and behavioral analytics.

IAiEcommerceFavorite.description:
Represents a single customer favoriting a product entry.
Links to ai_ecommerce_customer, ai_ecommerce_product, and optionally ai_ecommerce_favorite_tag, supporting recency analytics/features.

customer_id.description: The UUID of the customer who is favoriting the product. Must reference a valid customer account in the system.

product_id.description: The UUID of the product being marked as favorite by the customer. Must reference an existing, non-deleted product.

oneOf.description: (Optional) The UUID of a favorite tag/group owned by the customer. Can be null if no grouping/tag is desired.
(Optional) The UUID of a favorite tag/group owned by the customer. Can be null if no grouping/tag is desired.

favorite_tag_id.description: (Optional) The UUID of a favorite tag/group owned by the customer. Can be null if no grouping/tag is desired.

IAiEcommerceFavorite.ICreate.description: Payload for creating a favorite record. Used when a customer marks a product as favorite. Fulfills the per-customer/per-product uniqueness requirement and supports optional grouping/tagging. All UUIDs must reference valid, active entities.

oneOf.description: (Optional) The UUID of a favorite tag the favorite should be grouped under. Null for untagging. Only the owner may re-tag their favorites.
(Optional) The UUID of a favorite tag the favorite should be grouped under. Null for untagging. Only the owner may re-tag their favorites.

favorite_tag_id.description: (Optional) The UUID of a favorite tag the favorite should be grouped under. Null for untagging. Only the owner may re-tag their favorites.

IAiEcommerceFavorite.IUpdate.description: Payload for updating a favorite entity's tag/group. Only tag assignment may be updated—ownership and product reference are immutable.

name.description: Textual search for a tag name/label (case-insensitive, substring search allowed). Must reference only tags owned by the current authenticated customer.

IAiEcommerceFavoriteTag.IRequest.description: Query object for searching favorite tags belonging to the authenticated customer. Allows searching by tag name (partial match).

id.description: Unique identifier of the favorite tag (UUID).

customer_id.description: UUID of the customer who owns this tag.

name.description: Human-readable tag name/label. Must be unique per customer (case-insensitive uniqueness across their tag set).

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp for tag creation.

IAiEcommerceFavoriteTag.description: Favorite tag entity record. Used to group a customer's favorites under a custom, user-defined label. Each tag is owned by one customer and must have a unique name for that customer.

name.description: Desired new favorite tag name/label. Must be unique (ignoring case) among the tags owned by the current user.

IAiEcommerceFavoriteTag.ICreate.description: Payload for creating a new favorite tag. Owner is always the current authenticated customer. Tag names must be unique per customer.

name.description: The updated/new favorite tag name to assign. Must remain unique for the current customer.

IAiEcommerceFavoriteTag.IUpdate.description: Payload for updating a favorite tag's name for a customer. Only the owner can perform this update.

IPageIAiEcommerceFavoriteTag.description: Paginated response for a list search of favorite tags. Contains paging information and an array of tag records.

product_id.description: (Optional) Filter for a particular product's recommendations.

IAiEcommerceRecommendation.IRequest.description: Request/filter object for searching or listing product recommendations generated for the current user. Enables filtering by product, reason, or time window.

id.description: Unique identifier for the recommendation.

customer_id.description: UUID of the customer who received the recommendation.

product_id.description: UUID of the recommended product.

oneOf.description: (Optional) UUID of associated personalization snapshot if used. Null if standard recommendation.
(Optional) UUID of associated personalization snapshot if used. Null if standard recommendation.

snapshot_id.description: (Optional) UUID of associated personalization snapshot if used. Null if standard recommendation.

recommended_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when recommendation was generated.

oneOf.description: (Optional) Reason code for why this product was recommended, as generated by the AI model (e.g., 'similar_items').
(Optional) Reason code for why this product was recommended, as generated by the AI model (e.g., 'similar_items').

reason_code.description: (Optional) Reason code for why this product was recommended, as generated by the AI model (e.g., 'similar_items').

IAiEcommerceRecommendation.description: Recommendation entity record for the personalization system. One per customer/product/timestamp, with optional reference to personalization snapshot or reason code. Captures the atomic event of recommending a product to a customer at a point in time.

customer_id.description: UUID of customer for whom recommendation is created.

product_id.description: UUID of product being recommended.

oneOf.description: (Optional) Personalization snapshot's UUID, if the recommendation is snapshot-driven. Can be null.
(Optional) Personalization snapshot's UUID, if the recommendation is snapshot-driven. Can be null.

snapshot_id.description: (Optional) Personalization snapshot's UUID, if the recommendation is snapshot-driven. Can be null.

oneOf.description: (Optional) Code/annotation of recommendation reason. Null if none, or as specified by ML pipeline.
(Optional) Code/annotation of recommendation reason. Null if none, or as specified by ML pipeline.

reason_code.description: (Optional) Code/annotation of recommendation reason. Null if none, or as specified by ML pipeline.

IAiEcommerceRecommendation.ICreate.description: Payload for creating a new explicit recommendation record for a customer/product. Used for AI system feedback or explicit annotation.

oneOf.description: (Optional) Updated personalization snapshot UUID for context, if changing the reason/source.
(Optional) Updated personalization snapshot UUID for context, if changing the reason/source.

snapshot_id.description: (Optional) Updated personalization snapshot UUID for context, if changing the reason/source.

oneOf.description: (Optional) Correction or feedback for the AI/ML model. Provides contextual explainability or feedback label.
(Optional) Correction or feedback for the AI/ML model. Provides contextual explainability or feedback label.

reason_code.description: (Optional) Correction or feedback for the AI/ML model. Provides contextual explainability or feedback label.

IAiEcommerceRecommendation.IUpdate.description: Payload for updating a recommendation annotation (feedback, correction, or explainability). Only used for explicit corrections or ML feedback.

IPageIAiEcommerceRecommendation.description: Paged response for listing/searching recommendations. Returns the matching recommendation records and pagination info.

customerId.description:
The unique identifier of the customer associated with the snapshot.

Used to filter snapshots for a specific user in the platform. Reference to ai_ecommerce_snapshot.customer_id.

snapshotType.description:
The type of the personalization snapshot to search (e.g. 'favorites', 'settings', 'tags').

Allows clients to filter snapshots by functional context. Must match ai_ecommerce_snapshot.snapshot_type.

takenAfter.description: Lower bound of snapshot creation (ISO date-time, inclusive). Returns all snapshots taken at or after this timestamp. Used for range queries.

takenBefore.description: Upper bound of snapshot creation (ISO date-time, exclusive). Returns all snapshots taken before this timestamp. Used for historical/range queries.

sortKey.description: Field by which to sort the results (e.g., 'taken_at', 'snapshot_type'). Must reference a valid property in the snapshot schema.

oneOf.description: Sort order for results. Either 'asc' for ascending or 'desc' for descending order. Controls sort direction for sorting field.
Sort order for results. Either 'asc' for ascending or 'desc' for descending order. Controls sort direction for sorting field.

sortOrder.description: Sort order for results. Either 'asc' for ascending or 'desc' for descending order. Controls sort direction for sorting field.

oneOf.description: Page number to retrieve (1-based). Used for pagination. Nullable—if omitted/null, default is usually page 1.

page.description: Page number to retrieve (1-based). Used for pagination. Nullable—if omitted/null, default is usually page 1.

oneOf.description: Maximum number of results per page. Used for pagination, defaults to service/platform value if omitted. Nullable for default behaviour.

limit.description: Maximum number of results per page. Used for pagination, defaults to service/platform value if omitted. Nullable for default behaviour.

IAiEcommerceSnapshot.IRequest.description: Request structure for searching/collecting personalization snapshots. Contains filter, sort, and pagination parameters per ai_ecommerce_snapshot. Used to retrieve a subset of snapshot records for a user or admin.

pagination.description: Pagination details (current page, total pages, items per page, total count).

data.description: Array of personalization snapshot records matching the search/filter parameters.

IPageIAiEcommerceSnapshot.description: Container for paginated snapshot retrieval result. Returns metadata about page and set of IAiEcommerceSnapshot entries.

id.description: Unique identifier for the personalization snapshot (ai_ecommerce_snapshot.id).

customerId.description: Reference to the customer for whom the snapshot was taken (ai_ecommerce_snapshot.customer_id).

snapshotType.description: Describes the type of snapshot ('favorites', 'settings', 'tags', etc.) as recorded in ai_ecommerce_snapshot.snapshot_type.

takenAt.description: Timestamp when the snapshot was created (ai_ecommerce_snapshot.taken_at). ISO 8601 format.

blobUri.description: URI link (usually to cloud storage) where the full snapshot data is stored. Sourced from ai_ecommerce_snapshot.blob_uri.

IAiEcommerceSnapshot.description: Record representing a single personalization snapshot as captured by ai_ecommerce_snapshot table. Used for export, restore, or audit of user state at a given point.

customerId.description: ID of the customer for whom this snapshot is being recorded. See ai_ecommerce_snapshot.customer_id.

snapshotType.description: Functional context of the snapshot (e.g. 'favorites', 'settings', etc.). Should match allowed types in system logic. See ai_ecommerce_snapshot.snapshot_type.

takenAt.description: ISO 8601 date when snapshot was taken. If omitted, service sets current time.

blobUri.description: URI location of the full snapshot data (e.g., S3 or GCS bucket). ai_ecommerce_snapshot.blob_uri. Must be a valid URI or cloud storage location.

IAiEcommerceSnapshot.ICreate.description: Request structure for creating a new personalization snapshot for a user. Must provide customerId, snapshotType, takenAt, and blobUri.

snapshotType.description: If changing, sets the new functional context/type of the snapshot, e.g., from 'favorites' to 'tags', consistent with ai_ecommerce_snapshot.snapshot_type.

blobUri.description: Allows updating the URI to the stored snapshot blob (e.g., after moving storage locations).

takenAt.description: Updates the effective snapshot timestamp (when taken) if needed. Format: ISO 8601 date-time.

IAiEcommerceSnapshot.IUpdate.description: Update (partial modification) specification for an existing personalization snapshot. Allows changes to type, blob location, or snapshot timestamp. Used for metadata corrections.

id.description: The ID of the snapshot that was deleted.

status.description: Operation result status. E.g., 'deleted', 'not_found'.

deletedAt.description: Timestamp at which the snapshot was marked deleted. Optional, may be null if status is not 'deleted'.

IAiEcommerceSnapshot.IDeleteResult.description: Result structure returned after deleting (soft-deleting) a snapshot. Includes status/result and, if deleted, the timestamp.

customerId.description: ID of the customer for whom this config applies (user-specific personalization filter).

adminId.description: ID of the administrator who set the config (for admin/global scope configs).

configKey.description: Name of the personalization configuration to retrieve (e.g., 'ai_model_version', 'feature_flag').

appliedAfter.description: Lower bound (inclusive) for the applied_at timestamp for query range purposes. ISO date.

appliedBefore.description: Upper bound (exclusive) for the applied_at timestamp filter. ISO date.

limit.description: Number of items per page for pagination.

IAiEcommercePersonalizationConfig.IReque.description: Request structure for searching/listing personalization config records. Filters by customerId, adminId, configKey, and supports date filtering/pagination.

pagination.description: Pagination metadata (current/total page, limit, record count).

data.description: List of config objects in this page.

IPageIAiEcommercePersonalizationConfig.description: Paged result set for personalization config search. Includes metadata and an array of config objects.

id.description: Unique identifier for each personalization config row (ai_ecommerce_personalization_config.id).

adminId.description: Administrator who set/applied this config (ai_ecommerce_personalization_config.admin_id). Required for all admin/global configs.

oneOf.description: Customer user for whom config is set (ai_ecommerce_personalization_config.customer_id). Optional; null for admin/global configs.

customerId.description: Customer user for whom config is set (ai_ecommerce_personalization_config.customer_id). Optional; null for admin/global configs.

configKey.description: Name/key of the personalization config. Used for AI model selection, feature toggles, etc. (ai_ecommerce_personalization_config.config_key).

configValue.description: Associated value for the personalization config key. May be string, URI, or blob reference depending on key type. (ai_ecommerce_personalization_config.config_value).

appliedAt.description: Date/time when config was applied to the user or system (ai_ecommerce_personalization_config.applied_at). ISO date-time format.

IAiEcommercePersonalizationConfig.description: Represents a record of personalization config for a customer or system, stored in ai_ecommerce_personalization_config. Used for AI tuning, feature toggles, user-specific models, etc.

adminId.description: Administrator ID applying or creating this config. Required for record creation.

oneOf.description: If present, targets config at a specific user. Null for global/admin configs.

customerId.description: If present, targets config at a specific user. Null for global/admin configs.

configKey.description: Configuration key/name. Example: 'ai_model_version', 'homepage_rec_strategy'. Required for record creation.

configValue.description: Associated value/text/URI for this config key. Example: 'v2.3', 'featureA:true', or blob URI.

appliedAt.description: Timestamp when this config becomes active for user/system. ISO date-time (ai_ecommerce_personalization_config.applied_at).

IAiEcommercePersonalizationConfig.ICreat.description: Payload for creating a personalization config. adminId/configKey/configValue/appliedAt required. customerId optional/null for admin/system scope.

configKey.description: Update the key/name of the config (if re-keying is supported).

configValue.description: Updates/tweaks the value, model reference, toggle, or blob associated with this config name.

appliedAt.description: Update for the effective-applied date for this config (ISO date-time).

IAiEcommercePersonalizationConfig.IUpdat.description: Update payload for a personalization config. Allows modifying key, value, or application timestamp. Only mutable fields as per ai_ecommerce_personalization_config.

id.description: ID of the personalization config that was deleted.

status.description: Status/result of the operation.

oneOf.description: Deletion timestamp if successful (ISO format), or null if not deleted.

deletedAt.description: Deletion timestamp if successful (ISO format), or null if not deleted.

IAiEcommercePersonalizationConfig.IDelet.description: Result of delete operation for a personalization config. Status, optionally deletion time.

IAiEcommercePersonalizationAnalytics.IRe.description:
Request schema for searching, filtering, and paginating personalization analytics events within the AI E-Commerce Platform. This type supports parameters to filter analytics records by customer, admin, product, event type, event details, time ranges, and supports controls for pagination and sorting.

Used for administering dashboards, customer engagement analytics, regulatory queries, and platform personalization insights. Descriptions and constraints for each property referenced from the ai_ecommerce_personalization_analytics model and requirements document.

customer_id.description:
Reference to customer entity whose analytics events are requested. Filters for analytics events triggered by this customer.

Use-case: self-service engagement log or targeted admin audit.

admin_id.description: Reference to platform administrator whose activity (if any) impacted analytics event. Allows filtering for events traced to admin actions—useful for compliance or investigation flows.

product_id.description: Optional filter for analytics events involving a specific product. Use to analyze engagement or event history for a single SKU/product.

event_type.description: Event type filter for searching analytics records (e.g., 'favorite_add', 'rec_click', 'rec_remove'). Refer to event_type business rules, use only supported events. Typically a required or optional filter for dashboards.

event_at_from.description: Start of period for event occurrence filter (inclusive). ISO8601 UTC. For time-based range query—analytic period.

event_at_to.description: End of period for event occurrence filter (inclusive). ISO8601 UTC. Used with event_at_from for period queries.

details_json.description: Allow text search on analytics event details payload (JSON). Matches search substrings or keywords in additional metadata.

sort_by.description: Optional sort field name (e.g., 'event_at', 'event_type'). Determines primary order of paginated event list; refer to schema property names.

descending.description: If true, sorts results by sort_by in descending order (default: false).

limit.description: Pagination: number of items per page (1~100 recommended).

IPageIAiEcommercePersonalizationAnalytic.description:
Paginated result structure for personalized analytics.

Contains metadata for pagination as well as the actual list of analytics event records returned for the given query/page.

data.description: List of analytics event objects on this page. Each item conforms to IAiEcommercePersonalizationAnalytics or its variants.

IAiEcommercePersonalizationAnalytics.description:
Represents a single personalization analytics event record as tracked in ai_ecommerce_personalization_analytics.

Used for auditing customer/admin personalization engagement—recording events like favorite add/remove, recommendation interaction, etc. Properties fully align with table and documentation.

id.description: Primary key UUID of the analytics event row.

customer_id.description: References the customer involved in the personalization event. Foreign key.

admin_id.description: References the platform admin (if any) involved (nullable).

product_id.description: References the product related to the event (nullable).

event_type.description: Describes the type of personalization event (e.g., 'favorite_add', 'rec_click').

event_at.description: Exact UTC timestamp of the analytics event occurrence.

details_json.description: Opaque detail JSON payload for extensible analytic event data.

aiEcommercePersonalizationAnalytics.ICre.description:
Creation payload for a new personalization analytics event record. Used to register customer/admin actions/events in the analytics table.

Aligns with write patterns to ai_ecommerce_personalization_analytics, supporting extensibility and compliance.

customer_id.description: References the customer for whom the event is recorded (required).

admin_id.description: References the administrator involved (nullable) in the event.

product_id.description: References the involved product (nullable); only if event is tied to a concrete product.

event_type.description: Enum or string describing the event type (must match platform logic: e.g., 'favorite_add'). Required.

event_at.description: Timestamp of the event, in UTC ISO8601 format (required).

details_json.description: Optional event metadata/details as JSON-encoded string for custom analytics.

aiEcommercePersonalizationAnalytics.description:
Represents the ai_ecommerce_personalization_analytics model for return/read-only workflows.

Covers all atomic properties for analytics event entity. Used for domain read models, API return structures, and detailed view. Fields reflect current analytic event state in DB.

id.description: Event primary key (UUID).

customer_id.description: References associated customer (FK).

product_id.description: Product FK associated to the event (nullable).

aiEcommercePersonalizationAnalytics.IUpd.description:
Update payload for a personalization analytics event record. Supports correcting event_type, event_at, details_json, or actor references (per compliance or rare correction workflows). All fields optional to support patch/partial update scenarios.

Adheres to atomic update and audit requirements for analytics event modification.

product_id.description: Update product reference (nullable).

event_type.description: Update the event type if correction is needed.

event_at.description: Update the event occurrence timestamp (ISO8601 UTC).

details_json.description: Update the details/metadata JSON payload (free-form blob).

aiEcommerceAuditLogs.IRequest.description: Request/filter structure for searching audit log events (ai_ecommerce_audit_logs). Used for compliance, analytics, and operational audit trail querying. Follows audit schema for filtering by actor, type, target context, period, description, and supports pagination and sorting controls.

actor_customer_id.description: Filter for logs by customer-actor (UUID reference).

action_type.description: Filter for audit events by event type (e.g., 'login').

created_at_from.description: Audit search lower-bound time in UTC.

created_at_to.description: Audit search upper-bound time in UTC.

description.description: Full-text search in audit description/context.

sort_by.description: Sort field name for result ordering.

limit.description: Page result size (row count per page).

aiEcommerceAuditLogs.IPage.description:
Paginated results object for audit logs (ai_ecommerce_audit_logs).

Contains metadata about pagination and the list of audit log objects (or summaries). Used for compliance dashboards or audit review flows.

Description and constraints fully referenced from platform requirements.

data.description: Array of audit log entries matching the search criteria.

aiEcommerceAuditLogs.description:
Represents a platform audit log event row (ai_ecommerce_audit_logs). Each atomic log records one user/system/business/security action for full traceability.

Aligns with table schema and requirements documentation. Fields include polymorphic actor refs, event context, action type, object, description, timestamps, and logical deletion state. Used for read-only and compliance workflows.

Descriptions reference schema comments and usage guidelines.

id.description: Primary unique identifier for audit event.

actor_customer_id.description: UUID of customer actor for this event (nullable).

target_id.description: FK to affected entity (UUID in target_table).

description.description: Free text event/context note.

created_at.description: UTC ISO8601 for log write time.

deleted_at.description: Soft delete timestamp; null if active.

aiEcommerceAuditLogs.ICreate.description: API request to create a new atomic audit log entry for compliance and activity traceability. Follows ai_ecommerce_audit_logs table schema—user, seller, admin actors all possible, with strict references. Input must reflect an atomic platform action, with all required business context, object, and event annotation.

action_type.description: Type of action (string per action catalog).

target_id.description: FK to target entity in table.

description.description: Event/contextual note string on action.

aiEcommerceAuditLogs.IUpdate.description:
Update/correction request for an existing audit log record. Used for compliance or legal annotation only—never for core schema mutation.

All fields optional, only non-key/annotation fields updatable per compliance correction flows.

description.description: Updated or amended event/context description. Used for regulatory correction or annotation (GDPR, legal correction scenarios).

deleted_at.description: Mark as soft-deleted at given timestamp (for audit purposes; null if restoring/undelete).

action_type.description: Optional correction or update to action_type for audit trail (rare in compliant flows).

aiEcommerceSystemEvents.IRequest.description: Filter/pagination/search request for system events (ai_ecommerce_system_events). Used for monitoring integrations, automation, event-driven triggers. Supports advanced filtering by event_type, business object, affected entity, payload search, and comprehensive pagination controls.

target_table.description: Business table or context affected (optional filter).

target_id.description: UUID of entity affected by event (optional filter).

payload_json.description: Full-text search filter within event payload body (match any substring in JSON).

limit.description: Row count per page.

aiEcommerceSystemEvents.IPage.description:
aiEcommerceSystemEvents.IPage는 ai_ecommerce_system_events 레코드의 페이지네이션 목록을 반환한다.

이 타입은 시스템 이벤트 로그를 대량으로 검색하거나 이벤트 관리를 위한 조회 시 결과로 사용된다. 실제 비즈니스에서는 수십만 개 이상의 이벤트가 기록될 수 있으므로, 이 타입은 API의 응답에서 필수적이다. 페이징 정보와 데이터 배열로 구성되어 있다.

표준 IPage 패턴(페이지 정보와 data 배열 적용)에 기반한다.

pagination.description: 페이지네이션 정보를 담고 있다. 현재 페이지, 전체 페이지, 레코드 개수, 페이지당 개수 등을 포함한다.

data.description: 조회된 시스템 이벤트 레코드의 배열.

aiEcommerceSystemEvents.description:
aiEcommerceSystemEvents 타입은 ai_ecommerce_system_events 데이터베이스 테이블의 각 시스템 이벤트 레코드의 전체 스냅샷을 의미한다.

이 엔티티는 시스템 통합 이벤트(예: 외부 결제 콜백, 주문 생성, 도메인 이벤트 등)를 별도로 보존하며, 고도의 추적성과 영지식 감사(Compliant Audit)에 중점을 두고 있다. 마이크로서비스, 외부 연동, 실시간 분석, 장애 대응, 규제 준수 상황에서 사용된다.

eiEcommerceSystemEvents는 이벤트 타입 식별자, 타겟 비즈니스 개체, 페이로드, 생성 시각 등 정보를 반드시 포함한다.

id.description: 이벤트 PK(프라이머리 키). 시스템 이벤트의 고유 식별자. UUID 형식 사용.

event_type.description: 이벤트의 구체적 타입명. 예: 'order_created', 'payment_callback' 등. 각 도메인 이벤트/인티그레이션 목적별로 식별.

target_table.description: 이 이벤트가 연관된 비즈니스 테이블명. 예: 'ai_ecommerce_order', 'ai_ecommerce_product' 등.

payload_json.description: 이벤트의 상세 정보를 보관하는 json 인코딩된 문자열(payload). 구조체, 객체, 원시타입 통일 없이 텍스트로 저장. 규제/감사에 대응하는 원본 이벤트 저장소 역할.

created_at.description: 이벤트 기록/생성시각. (ISO 8601 형식)

aiEcommerceSystemEvents.ICreate.description:
aiEcommerceSystemEvents.ICreate는 ai_ecommerce_system_events 테이블에 새로운 시스템 이벤트 로그를 생성할 때 사용되는 요청 바디 타입이다.

이 타입은 반드시 이벤트의 타입명, 타겟 비즈니스 테이블/ID, 전체 payload, 생성 시각 등을 포함해야 한다. RESTful POST 엔드포인트, 마이크로서비스 이벤트-브로커 발행 등에서 사용된다. AI쇼핑몰 백엔드에서는 결제 콜백, 외부 이벤트, 내부 도메인 이벤트 등 시스템 통합 상황에서 자동으로 사용될 수도 있다.

event_type.description: 기록할 시스템 이벤트의 타입명. 예: 'order_created', 'payment_callback', 'inventory_sync' 등 비즈니스/도메인/외부 연결 이벤트 식별자.

target_table.description: 이벤트가 연관된 비즈니스 테이블명 또는 엔티티 명칭. 예: 'ai_ecommerce_order'.

payload_json.description: 이벤트의 구체 정보/맥락을 json 인코딩 후 문자열로 저장한다. 시스템간 연동, 외부 서비스 연결, 리스크 감시 등에 활용.

created_at.description: 이벤트 발생 및 기록 시각. (ISO 8601 형식)

aiEcommerceSystemEvents.IUpdate.description:
aiEcommerceSystemEvents.IUpdate는 기존 시스템 이벤트 로그(ai_ecommerce_system_events)의 일부 속성(주로 payload, event_type, target 정보 등)을 교정하거나 후처리(meta 수동수정) 목적으로 사용하는 업데이트 요청 타입이다.

규제, 장애/집계 교정, devops의 재분류, 감사 조치 등에 한정적으로 사용한다. 생성된 이벤트의 기록 값을 후처리해야 하는 경우에만 이용하는 것이 원칙이다.

event_type.description: 재분류/정정이 필요한 경우, 수정할 이벤트 타입명.

target_table.description: 수정할 비즈니스 테이블명, 관리상 필요할 경우 변경.

target_id.description: 비즈니스 로우 PK(UUID) – 필요에 따라 교정 가능.

IAiEcommerceComplianceAudits.IRequest.description:
IAiEcommerceComplianceAudits.IRequest 타입은 ai_ecommerce_compliance_audits 레코드의 목록 혹은 필터링, 페이징, 소팅 기준을 전달할 때 사용한다.

주요 활용: 관리/대시보드에서 감사이벤트를 조건검색/정렬/필터/페이지로 나누어 요청할 때 사용. 직접 조회(예: 관리콘솔, 규제대응, 외부감사)마다 다양한 조합으로 요청이 발생한다.

status, audit_type, subject_table, admin, created_at 기간, 전용 full-text 등 다양하게 조합 가능.

status.description: 검색하고자 하는 감사 상태. 'pending', 'approved', 'rejected'등의 규제 상태 지정에 사용. 설정안할시 전체.

audit_type.description: 감사 유형 필터. 예: 'GDPR Delete', 'PCI Review' 등 특정 유형 감사만 조회하고자 할 때 지정.

subject_table.description: 감사대상이 되는 테이블/entity명을 명확히 지정. 예: 'ai_ecommerce_order', 'ai_ecommerce_customer' 등.

admin_id.description: 관리자가 특정한 경우, 해당 감사 실행 주체/관리자 PK(uuid)로 필터.

created_from.description: 조회 기간(시작). ISO8601 시각. 기간검색에 사용, 미지정시 무시.

created_to.description: 조회 기간(끝). ISO8601, 위 조건과 조합시 사용.

limit.description: 페이지당 표출될 결과 갯수.

sort.description: 정렬 필드/옵션(ex: created_at desc 등 직렬화 문자열).

query.description: 노트 또는 기타 텍스트 기반 내용 전체/부분일치 검색용.

IPageIAiEcommerceComplianceAudits.description:
IPageIAiEcommerceComplianceAudits는 ai_ecommerce_compliance_audits의 리스트/페이지 결과를 반환하는 표준 타입이다.

페이징 정보+데이터 리스트로 구성, 관리패널/감사대시보드(규제,법률 등)에서 감사이벤트를 여러건씩 불러올 때 필수다.

공통적으로 내부 필드 pagination+data 배열 제공.

pagination.description: 페이지네이션 데이터 – 현재페이지, 한 페이지당 레코드 수, 전체 레코드수, 전체 페이지수.

data.description: 페이징된 ai_ecommerce_compliance_audits 레코드들의 배열.

IAiEcommerceComplianceAudits.description:
IAiEcommerceComplianceAudits는 ai_ecommerce_compliance_audits 테이블상의 단일 레코드 구조, 즉 단일 컴플라이언스 감사 이벤트의 모든 속성을 정의한다.

이 타입은 GDPR, KISA, PCI-DSS 등 다양한 글로벌/지역 규제대응·감사(법정, 내부, 외부) 상황에서 사용된다. 관리자, 감사관, IT보안 책임자가 데이터를 직접 조회하거나, 증거수집·보고서 생성에서 필수적이다.

주요 필드: 감사 PK(id), 관리자(admin_id), 감사종류(audit_type), 대상엔티티(subject_table/subject_id), 상태(status), 상세설명(notes), 생성시각(created_at).

각 감사타입은 감사대상 테이블/ID마다 고유히 조합됨.

id.description: 이 레코드의 고유 PK(UUID). 감사이벤트 단위 기준.

admin_id.description: 감사 실행 담당자 PK (ai_ecommerce_administrator의 id). null 허용(자동 감사 등 시스템이 진행할 경우).

audit_type.description: 규제, 업무별 감사구분. 예: 'GDPR Delete', 'PCI Review', 'KISA' 등.

status.description: 감사 진행상태. 예: 'pending', 'approved', 'rejected' 등. 이 값은 비즈니스 규칙 및 테이블/운영정책에서 해석.

notes.description: 감사 상세 사유, 코멘트, 감사경과 요약. 자유서술식 텍스트.

created_at.description: 감사 이벤트 기록시각. ISO8601 포맷.

IAiEcommerceComplianceAudits.ICreate.description:
IAiEcommerceComplianceAudits.ICreate는 ai_ecommerce_compliance_audits에 신규 감사 레코드를 생성할 때 사용하는 타입이다.

관리자(담당자) 또는 자동화 프로세스가 감사 이벤트를 기록할 때 전송한다. 정책별 감사구분, 테이블명/ID, 감사사유, 상태, 시각 등을 포함한다.

자동화/수동 감사 모두 동일 구조 활용. 생성 결과는 IAiEcommerceComplianceAudits 형태로 반환됨.

admin_id.description: 실행 관리자 PK, 시스템 자동일 때 null. (관리자 연동시 필수, 자동은 optional).

audit_type.description: 새 감사 구분. 예: GDPR Delete, KISA, PCI Review 등.

status.description: 진행상태. pending, approved, rejected 등.

created_at.description: 감사 이벤트 기록시점(ISO 8601 date/time).

IAiEcommerceComplianceAudits.IUpdate.description:
IAiEcommerceComplianceAudits.IUpdate는 ai_ecommerce_compliance_audits 테이블의 기존 감사 이벤트 내용을 일부 수정할 때 사용하는 타입이다.

주요 사용처는 감사경과 메모 보완, 행정/법률적 증거 자료 보강, 상태 진전/회수 등이다. 생성 시점 등 일부 필드는 불변이며, 개정가능한 필드(상태, notes, 담당자 등) 중심으로 입력한다.

admin_id.description: 감사를 담당할 관리자의 PK(uuid) 수정시 기입.

status.description: 감사상태 변경(예: pending → approved 등).

notes.description: 감사 상세 사유 및 코멘트 보완/수정.

authorization.name: customer
authorization.description: Individual users who can browse products, place orders, manage favorites, write reviews/inquiries, and access personalized features after authenticating via API. Customers may be members, guests, or external platform users.

authorization.name: seller
authorization.description: Authenticated business users who can list, manage, and fulfill products, view analytics, issue coupons, and respond to inquiries or reviews. Sellers manage their product catalogs and order workflow via API.

authorization.name: administrator
authorization.description: Platform-wide managers with permissions for system configuration, seller onboarding, channel management, marketing tools, and regulatory/audit modules. Administrators can access all system APIs for operational and analytic purposes.
